### Correlation of the features with pathogenicity and ANI

Spearman correlations (t approximation for p) of each feature with (i) decayed tissue weight, (ii) reported ANI and (iii) pitting score, for all isolates and within the two ANI tiers of Figure 8; `n.a.` where a variable does not vary. Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment across the four features within each outcome and subset. The effector flag is coded 0/1, with a Wilcoxon rank-sum test alongside.

```{r genomic-feature-stats}
feat_levels <- c("pectin", "hemicellulose", "cellulose", "effector")
feat_lab    <- c(pectin = "Pectin-like PCWDE genes", hemicellulose = "Hemicellulose-like PCWDE genes",
                 cellulose = "Cellulose-like PCWDE genes", effector = "Effector candidate")
subset_def  <- setNames(list(rep(TRUE, nrow(geno)), geno$ani >= 95, geno$ani < 95), c("All isolates", tier_hi, tier_lo))

safe_spearman <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- complete.cases(x, y); x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]; n <- length(x)
  if (n < 4)                                   return(tibble(n = n, rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, note = "n < 4"))
  if (length(unique(x)) < 2 || length(unique(y)) < 2) return(tibble(n = n, rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, note = "no variation"))
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  tibble(n = n, rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value, note = "")
}

cor_tab <- expand_grid(outcome = c("decay_g", "ani", "pitting"), subset = names(subset_def), feature = feat_levels) %>%
  mutate(res = pmap(list(outcome, subset, feature), function(o, s, f) {
    d <- geno[which(subset_def[[s]]), ]
    safe_spearman(d[[f]], d[[o]])
  })) %>%
  unnest(res) %>%
  group_by(outcome, subset) %>% mutate(q_bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(outcome_lab = c(decay_g = "Decayed tissue weight", ani = "Reported ANI", pitting = "Pitting score on CVP agar")[outcome],
         feature_lab = feat_lab[feature])
write_tab(cor_tab, "T_genomic_features_spearman")
print(cor_tab %>% select(outcome, subset, feature, n, rho, p, q_bh, note) %>% mutate(across(c(rho, p, q_bh), ~ signif(., 3))), n = Inf)

# Effector candidate vs decayed tissue weight, Wilcoxon rank-sum (exact when there are no ties)
eff_tab <- map_dfr(names(subset_def), function(s) {
  d <- geno[which(subset_def[[s]]), ] %>% filter(!is.na(decay_g))
  out <- tibble(subset = s, n_yes = sum(d$effector == 1), n_no = sum(d$effector == 0),
                median_decay_yes = median(d$decay_g[d$effector == 1]), median_decay_no = median(d$decay_g[d$effector == 0]),
                W = NA_real_, p = NA_real_)
  if (out$n_yes >= 1 && out$n_no >= 1) {
    wt <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(decay_g ~ effector, data = d))
    out$W <- unname(wt$statistic); out$p <- wt$p.value
  }
  out
})
write_tab(eff_tab, "T_effector_candidate_vs_decay")
print(eff_tab)

# Pitting score against decayed tissue weight: the sequenced isolates (those of Figure 10) and every isolate that has both
# (one Spearman test per row; the rows overlap, so no adjustment across them)
pit_sets <- list("All isolates with both scores"   = isolates %>% transmute(isolate_code, pitting, decay_g, ani = ani_numeric),
                 "Sequenced isolates (PCWDE data)" = geno %>% transmute(isolate_code, pitting, decay_g, ani))
pit_decay_tab <- map_dfr(names(pit_sets), function(nm) {
  d <- pit_sets[[nm]] %>% filter(!is.na(pitting), !is.na(decay_g))
  map_dfr(c("All isolates", tier_hi, tier_lo), function(s) {
    keep <- if (s == "All isolates") rep(TRUE, nrow(d)) else if (s == tier_hi) !is.na(d$ani) & d$ani >= 95 else !is.na(d$ani) & d$ani < 95
    safe_spearman(d$pitting[keep], d$decay_g[keep]) %>% mutate(set = nm, subset = s, .before = 1)
  })
})
write_tab(pit_decay_tab, "T_pitting_vs_decay")
print(pit_decay_tab %>% mutate(across(c(rho, p), ~ signif(., 3))))

# Decayed tissue weight and enzyme genes by pitting score, sequenced isolates
med <- function(x) if (any(!is.na(x))) median(x, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
pit_score_tab <- geno %>% filter(!is.na(pit_chr)) %>% mutate(pit_f = factor(pit_chr, pit_levels)) %>%
  group_by(pit_f, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), n_ani_hi = sum(tier == tier_hi), n_with_decay = sum(!is.na(decay_g)), decay_median_g = med(decay_g),
            decay_min_g = ifelse(n_with_decay > 0, min(decay_g, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_), decay_max_g = ifelse(n_with_decay > 0, max(decay_g, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
            pectin_median = med(pectin), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(pitting = as.character(pit_f), .before = 1) %>% select(-pit_f)
write_tab(pit_score_tab, "T_pitting_score_summary_sequenced")
print(pit_score_tab, width = Inf)

# Feature values and decay by ANI tier
tier_tab <- geno %>% group_by(tier) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), n_with_decay = sum(!is.na(decay_g)),
            across(c(pectin, hemicellulose, cellulose), list(min = min, median = median, max = max), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
            effector_yes = sum(effector), decay_median_g = median(decay_g, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(tier = as.character(tier))
write_tab(tier_tab, "T_genomic_features_by_ani_tier")
print(tier_tab, width = Inf)

# Isolates with an identical PCWDE profile but a different decayed tissue weight (ANI >= 95% tier)
prof_tab <- geno %>% filter(!is.na(decay_g), ani >= 95) %>%
  group_by(pectin, hemicellulose, cellulose) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), isolates = paste(isolate_code, collapse = ", "), pitting = paste(ifelse(is.na(pit_chr), "n.t.", pit_chr), collapse = " "), decay_min_g = min(decay_g),
            decay_median_g = median(decay_g), decay_max_g = max(decay_g), fold_max_over_min = max(decay_g) / min(decay_g), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(pectin), desc(cellulose))
write_tab(prof_tab, "T_identical_pcwde_profiles_decay")
print(prof_tab, width = Inf)
```
# Statistics

**Unit of analysis.** The plant tested (one stem per plant; "Plants tested" in Table 1); a plant is positive for a target when its stem is qPCR-positive. Plants of one sample are not independent, so 95% confidence intervals are cluster-adjusted exact (Clopper-Pearson) intervals with samples as clusters (as `survey::svyciprop(method = "beta")`), and tests are GEE logistic models with one cluster per sample and robust standard errors (variety: Rao-Scott test). P values within a contrast across the four targets are Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted. Sample-level analyses (a sample is positive when at least one plant is positive) are kept as a sensitivity analysis. Per-plant status is available for 2026 only, so co-detection (Figure 4) is exact for 2026 and bounded for 2024-2025.

## Prevalence by season

```{r stats-setup}
# ---- generic summary helpers --------------------------------------------------
summ_prev <- function(df, by, level = c("any", "stem")) {
  level <- match.arg(level)
  long <- map_dfr(keys, function(k) {
    df %>% group_by(across(all_of(by))) %>%
      summarise(target = k,
                n   = if (level == "any") n() else sum(n_stems),
                pos = if (level == "any") sum(.data[[paste0("any_", k)]]) else sum(.data[[paste0("n_pos_", k)]]),
                .groups = "drop")
  })
  ci <- t(mapply(cp_prop, long$pos, long$n))
  long %>% mutate(pct = 100 * pos / n, lo = 100 * ci[, 1], hi = 100 * ci[, 2],
                  target_lab = factor(targets[target], levels = targets))
}

# ---- plant level: plants tested nested in samples ---------------------------------------------------------
# Cluster-adjusted exact interval for a proportion of plants (samples are the clusters): design effect of the ratio estimator (at least 1), effective n = n / deff
# with the Korn-Graubard correction (as survey::svyciprop(method = "beta")). If every or no plant is positive, the exact interval on the number of samples is used.
cp_clust <- function(x, n, level = .95) {
  a <- 1 - level; N <- sum(n); X <- sum(x); m <- length(n); p <- X / N
  cp <- function(xx, nn) c(lo = if (xx <= 0) 0 else qbeta(a / 2, xx, nn - xx + 1), hi = if (xx >= nn) 1 else qbeta(1 - a / 2, xx + 1, nn - xx))
  if (X == 0 || X == N) return(c(cp(if (X == N) m else 0, m), deff = NA_real_))
  if (m < 2) return(c(cp(X, N), deff = NA_real_))
  v <- m / (m - 1) * sum((x - p * n)^2) / N^2
  deff <- max(1, v / (p * (1 - p) / N))
  ne <- (N / deff) * (qt(a / 2, N - 1) / qt(a / 2, m - 1))^2
  c(cp(p * ne, ne), deff = deff)
}
# Prevalence of plants by group: samples, plants tested (n), positive plants (pos), percentage, cluster-adjusted exact interval, design effect.
summ_plant <- function(dat, by) {
  map_dfr(keys, function(k) {
    dat %>% group_by(across(all_of(by))) %>%
      summarise(target = k, samples = n(), n = sum(n_stems), pos = sum(.data[[paste0("n_pos_", k)]]),
                ci = list(cp_clust(.data[[paste0("n_pos_", k)]], n_stems)), .groups = "drop")
  }) %>%
    mutate(pct = 100 * pos / n, lo = 100 * map_dbl(ci, "lo"), hi = 100 * map_dbl(ci, "hi"), deff = map_dbl(ci, "deff"),
           target_lab = factor(targets[target], levels = targets)) %>% select(-ci)
}
# One row per plant tested: y = 1 if the plant is positive for target k, cl = the sample (row of dat) the plant belongs to.
plant_rows <- function(dat, k) {
  idx <- rep(seq_len(nrow(dat)), dat$n_stems)
  out <- dat[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  out$y <- unlist(map2(dat[[paste0("n_pos_", k)]], dat$n_stems, ~ c(rep(1L, .x), rep(0L, .y - .x))), use.names = FALSE)
  out$cl <- idx
  out
}
gee_fit <- function(form, d) geeglm(form, id = cl, data = d, family = binomial, corstr = "independence")
# Two groups of plants (levels lv of column grp; odds ratio of lv[2] against lv[1]); NA with a note if a group has no positive or no negative plant.
gee_pair <- function(d, grp, lv) {
  dd <- d[d[[grp]] %in% lv, ]; dd$g <- factor(as.character(dd[[grp]]), levels = lv)
  tab <- table(dd$g, dd$y)
  if (any(dim(tab) < 2) || any(tab == 0)) return(tibble(or = NA_real_, lo = NA_real_, hi = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, note = "zero cell"))
  s <- summary(gee_fit(y ~ g, dd))$coefficients[2, ]
  tibble(or = exp(s$Estimate), lo = exp(s$Estimate - 1.96 * s$Std.err), hi = exp(s$Estimate + 1.96 * s$Std.err), p = s[["Pr(>|W|)"]], note = "")
}
# Robust Wald chi-square test of the terms that are in `full` and not in `reduced`.
gee_wald <- function(d, full, reduced) {
  tryCatch({ a <- anova(gee_fit(reduced, d), gee_fit(full, d)); tibble(chisq = a$X2, df = a$Df, p = a$`P(>|Chi|)`, note = "") },
           error = function(e) tibble(chisq = NA_real_, df = NA_integer_, p = NA_real_, note = "model did not converge"))
}
gee_tidy <- function(m, model, k, d) {
  s <- summary(m)$coefficients
  tibble(model = model, target = k, term = rownames(s), or = exp(s[, "Estimate"]), lo = exp(s[, "Estimate"] - 1.96 * s[, "Std.err"]),
         hi = exp(s[, "Estimate"] + 1.96 * s[, "Std.err"]), p.value = s[, "Pr(>|W|)"], n_plants = nrow(d), n_samples = n_distinct(d$cl))
}
```
Prevalence by season for the plants tested (primary) and the samples (sensitivity). Plant level: GEE logistic models (Wald test across seasons; pairwise odds ratios of the later against the earlier season, with Wald and BH-adjusted p values; not estimable when a group has no positive or no negative plants). Sample level: Fisher exact tests; risk ratio with Haldane-Anscombe correction when a cell is zero.

```{r stats-prevalence}
# ---- 1. overall prevalence by season ------------------------------------------
prev_sample <- summ_prev(S, "year", "any")
prev_plant  <- summ_plant(S, "year")
write_tab(prev_sample, "T_prevalence_sample_level_by_year")
write_tab(prev_plant,  "T_prevalence_plant_level_by_year")

# omnibus + pairwise tests (Fisher), BH within each contrast across the four targets
rr_ci <- function(a, n1, b, n2) {                       # RR of group2 vs group1, Haldane-Anscombe if any zero cell
  if (any(c(a, b, n1 - a, n2 - b) == 0)) { a <- a + .5; b <- b + .5; n1 <- n1 + 1; n2 <- n2 + 1 }
  rr <- (b / n2) / (a / n1); se <- sqrt(1 / b - 1 / n2 + 1 / a - 1 / n1)
  c(rr = rr, lo = exp(log(rr) - 1.96 * se), hi = exp(log(rr) + 1.96 * se))
}
contrasts <- list(c("2024", "2025"), c("2025", "2026"), c("2024", "2026"))
run_tests <- function(prev, label) {
  omni <- map_dfr(keys, function(k) {
    d <- prev %>% filter(target == k); m <- cbind(d$pos, d$n - d$pos)
    tibble(target = k, test = "Fisher-Freeman-Halton (3 seasons)", p = fisher.test(m)$p.value)
  })
  pw <- map_dfr(contrasts, function(cc) map_dfr(keys, function(k) {
    a <- prev %>% filter(target == k, year == cc[1]); b <- prev %>% filter(target == k, year == cc[2])
    ft <- fisher.test(matrix(c(a$pos, a$n - a$pos, b$pos, b$n - b$pos), 2, byrow = TRUE))
    r <- rr_ci(a$pos, a$n, b$pos, b$n)
    tibble(contrast = paste(cc[2], "vs", cc[1]), target = k,
           pct_ref = a$pct, pct_cmp = b$pct, rr = r["rr"], rr_lo = r["lo"], rr_hi = r["hi"], p = ft$p.value)
  })) %>% group_by(contrast) %>% mutate(p_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>% ungroup()
  write_tab(omni, paste0("T_tests_omnibus_", label)); write_tab(pw, paste0("T_tests_pairwise_", label))
  list(omni = omni, pw = pw)
}
tests_sample <- run_tests(prev_sample, "sample_level")

# plant level (primary): GEE logistic models, plants nested in samples (cluster = sample), robust SE
pl_omni <- map_dfr(keys, function(k) {
  d <- plant_rows(S, k)
  if (any(table(d$year, d$y) == 0)) return(tibble(target = k, chisq = NA_real_, df = NA_integer_, p = NA_real_, note = "zero cell"))
  bind_cols(tibble(target = k), gee_wald(d, y ~ year, y ~ 1))
}) %>% mutate(test = "GEE Wald, plants clustered in samples (3 seasons)", p_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>% select(target, test, everything())
pl_pw <- map_dfr(keys, function(k) {
  d <- plant_rows(S, k); pp <- prev_plant %>% filter(target == k)
  map_dfr(contrasts, function(cc) bind_cols(
    tibble(contrast = paste(cc[2], "vs", cc[1]), target = k, pct_ref = pp$pct[pp$year == cc[1]], pct_cmp = pp$pct[pp$year == cc[2]]),
    gee_pair(d, "year", cc)))
}) %>% group_by(contrast) %>% mutate(p_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(contrast, target, pct_ref, pct_cmp, or, lo, hi, p, p_BH, note)
tests_plant <- list(omni = pl_omni, pw = pl_pw)
write_tab(pl_omni, "T_tests_omnibus_plant_level"); write_tab(pl_pw, "T_tests_pairwise_plant_level_GEE")
gee_res <- pl_pw    # the odds ratios drawn in Figure S1
```
## Seed generation

G2 vs G3 (the generations with enough samples). Plant level (primary): GEE logistic model with season and generation, odds ratio of G3 against G2 adjusted for season. Sample level (sensitivity): Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test stratified by season.

```{r stats-generation}
# ---- 2. seed generation (sample level) -----------------------------------------
gen_tab_sample <- summ_prev(S %>% filter(!is.na(generation)), c("year", "generation"), "any") %>%
  mutate(generation = factor(generation, levels = paste0("G", 1:4)))
write_tab(gen_tab_sample, "T_prevalence_by_generation_sample_level")
G23 <- S %>% filter(generation %in% c("G2", "G3")) %>% mutate(g3 = as.integer(generation == "G3"))
gen_test <- map_dfr(keys, function(k) {
  y <- paste0("any_", k)
  arr <- table(factor(G23$g3, 0:1, c("G2", "G3")), factor(G23[[y]], 0:1, c("neg", "pos")), G23$year)
  cmh <- tryCatch(mantelhaen.test(arr), error = function(e) NULL)
  by_year <- map_dfr(levels(S$year), function(yr) {
    a <- arr[, , yr]; ft <- fisher.test(a)
    tibble(year = yr, G2 = sprintf("%d/%d", a[1, 2], sum(a[1, ])), G3 = sprintf("%d/%d", a[2, 2], sum(a[2, ])), p_fisher = ft$p.value)
  })
  tibble(target = k, mh_or_G3_vs_G2 = cmh$estimate, mh_lo = cmh$conf.int[1], mh_hi = cmh$conf.int[2], mh_p = cmh$p.value) %>%
    bind_cols(by_year %>% pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = c(G2, G3, p_fisher), names_glue = "{.value}_{year}"))
})
write_tab(gen_test, "T_tests_generation_G3_vs_G2_CMH")

# ---- 2b. seed generation, plant level (primary) ---------------------------------------------------------------
gen_tab <- summ_plant(S %>% filter(!is.na(generation)), c("year", "generation")) %>%
  mutate(generation = factor(generation, levels = paste0("G", 1:4)))
write_tab(gen_tab, "T_prevalence_by_generation_plant_level")
G23p <- G23 %>% mutate(generation = factor(as.character(generation), c("G2", "G3")))
gen_res <- map(keys, function(k) {
  d <- plant_rows(G23p, k); m <- gee_fit(y ~ year + generation, d)
  cells <- gen_tab %>% filter(target == k, generation %in% c("G2", "G3")) %>% mutate(cell = sprintf("%d/%d", pos, n)) %>%
    select(generation, year, cell) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = c(generation, year), values_from = cell, names_sep = "_")
  co <- gee_tidy(m, "plant positive ~ year + generation (G2/G3)", k, d)
  g <- co %>% filter(term == "generationG3")
  list(coef = co, row = bind_cols(tibble(target = k, or_G3_vs_G2_adj_season = g$or, lo = g$lo, hi = g$hi, p = g$p.value), cells))
}) %>% setNames(keys)
gen_test_plant <- map_dfr(gen_res, "row") %>% mutate(p_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH"), .after = p)
write_tab(gen_test_plant, "T_tests_generation_G3_vs_G2_GEE")
gen_coef <- map_dfr(gen_res, "coef")
```
## Region

Plant level (primary): GEE logistic models with season and region (Wald test, 2 df; odds ratios of Dillon/Twin Bridges and Flathead against Gallatin Valley, adjusted for season). Sample level (sensitivity): Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test across seasons and Firth-type bias-reduced logistic models, which stay finite under the complete separation of *Pectobacterium* spp. in Dillon/Twin Bridges (every sample positive); at plant level three plants are negative, so there is no separation.

```{r stats-region}
# ---- 3. region (sample level) ---------------------------------------------------
reg_tab_sample <- summ_prev(SR, c("year", "region"), "any")
write_tab(reg_tab_sample, "T_prevalence_by_region_sample_level")
reg_test <- map_dfr(keys, function(k) {
  y <- paste0("any_", k)
  arr <- table(factor(SR$region), factor(SR[[y]], 0:1, c("neg", "pos")), SR$year)
  cmh <- tryCatch(mantelhaen.test(arr), error = function(e) NULL)
  by_year <- map_dbl(levels(SR$year), function(yr) fisher.test(arr[, , yr])$p.value)
  tibble(target = k, cmh_chisq = unname(cmh$statistic), cmh_df = unname(cmh$parameter), cmh_p = cmh$p.value,
         p_2024 = by_year[1], p_2025 = by_year[2], p_2026 = by_year[3])
})
write_tab(reg_test, "T_tests_region_CMH_adjusted_for_year")

# Firth-type (bias-reduced) logistic models: finite under complete separation (Pectobacterium spp. in Dillon/Twin Bridges).
fit_br <- function(form, data) glm(form, data = data, family = binomial, method = brglmFit, type = "AS_mean")
adj <- map_dfr(keys, function(k) {
  d <- SR %>% mutate(y = .data[[paste0("any_", k)]], region = relevel(factor(region), "Gallatin Valley"))
  m <- fit_br(y ~ year + region, d)
  tidy(m, conf.int = FALSE) %>% mutate(model = "any ~ year + region", target = k,
    or = exp(estimate), lo = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error), hi = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error), n = nrow(d))
})
adj_g <- map_dfr(keys, function(k) {
  d <- G23 %>% mutate(y = .data[[paste0("any_", k)]], generation = factor(generation, c("G2", "G3")))
  m <- fit_br(y ~ year + generation, d)
  tidy(m) %>% mutate(model = "any ~ year + generation (G2/G3)", target = k,
    or = exp(estimate), lo = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error), hi = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error), n = nrow(d))
})
write_tab(bind_rows(adj, adj_g) %>% select(model, target, term, or, lo, hi, p.value, n), "T_models_firth_logistic")

# ---- 3b. region, plant level (primary) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
reg_tab <- summ_plant(SR, c("year", "region"))
write_tab(reg_tab, "T_prevalence_by_region_plant_level")
SRg <- SR %>% mutate(region = relevel(factor(region), "Gallatin Valley"))
reg_res <- map(keys, function(k) {
  d <- plant_rows(SRg, k); m <- gee_fit(y ~ year + region, d)
  co <- gee_tidy(m, "plant positive ~ year + region", k, d)
  w <- gee_wald(d, y ~ year + region, y ~ year)
  r <- co %>% filter(grepl("^region", term)) %>% mutate(term = sub("^region", "", term))
  list(coef = co, row = bind_cols(tibble(target = k), w %>% select(chisq, df, p),
         tibble(or_Dillon = r$or[r$term == "Dillon/Twin Bridges"], lo_Dillon = r$lo[r$term == "Dillon/Twin Bridges"], hi_Dillon = r$hi[r$term == "Dillon/Twin Bridges"],
                p_Dillon = r$p.value[r$term == "Dillon/Twin Bridges"],
                or_Flathead = r$or[r$term == "Flathead"], lo_Flathead = r$lo[r$term == "Flathead"], hi_Flathead = r$hi[r$term == "Flathead"],
                p_Flathead = r$p.value[r$term == "Flathead"])))
}) %>% setNames(keys)
reg_test_plant <- map_dfr(reg_res, "row") %>% mutate(p_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH"), .after = p)
write_tab(reg_test_plant, "T_tests_region_GEE_adjusted_for_year")
write_tab(bind_rows(gen_coef, map_dfr(reg_res, "coef")), "T_models_gee_logistic")
```


## Co-occurrence and assay concordance


```{r stats-cooccurrence}
# ---- 4. co-occurrence (sample level, three seasons; per-plant joint status exists only for 2026, see Figure S2) ----
jacc <- function(a, b) { u <- sum(a == 1 | b == 1); if (u == 0) NA else sum(a == 1 & b == 1) / u }
jac_all <- map_dfr(levels(S$year), function(yr) {
  d <- S %>% filter(year == yr)
  expand_grid(t1 = keys, t2 = keys) %>%
    mutate(year = yr, jaccard = map2_dbl(t1, t2, ~ jacc(d[[paste0("any_", .x)]], d[[paste0("any_", .y)]])))
})
write_tab(jac_all, "T_jaccard_sample_level_by_year")
cls <- S %>% mutate(class = case_when(
  any_pectobacterium_spp == 1 & any_dickeya_spp == 1 ~ "Both genera",
  any_pectobacterium_spp == 1 ~ "Pectobacterium only",
  any_dickeya_spp == 1 ~ "Dickeya only", TRUE ~ "Neither")) %>%
  count(year, class) %>% group_by(year) %>% mutate(N = sum(n), pct = 100 * n / N) %>% ungroup()
write_tab(cls, "T_genus_cooccurrence_classes_by_year")
cross <- map_dfr(levels(S$year), function(yr) {
  d <- S %>% filter(year == yr); m <- table(factor(d$any_pectobacterium_spp, 0:1), factor(d$any_dickeya_spp, 0:1))
  ft <- fisher.test(m); tibble(year = yr, pec_pos_dick_pos = m[2, 2], pec_pos_dick_neg = m[2, 1], pec_neg_dick_pos = m[1, 2],
                               pec_neg_dick_neg = m[1, 1], or = ft$estimate, p = ft$p.value)
})
write_tab(cross, "T_pectobacterium_x_dickeya_association_by_year")
disc <- S %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(
  species_pos_genus_neg_Pa = sum(any_p_atrosepticum == 1 & any_pectobacterium_spp == 0),
  species_pos_genus_neg_Dd = sum(any_d_dianthicola == 1 & any_dickeya_spp == 0),
  genus_pos_species_neg_Dickeya = sum(any_dickeya_spp == 1 & any_d_dianthicola == 0),
  genus_pos_species_neg_Pec = sum(any_pectobacterium_spp == 1 & any_p_atrosepticum == 0), n = n())
write_tab(disc, "T_assay_concordance_by_year")

# ---- 4b. co-occurrence, plant level -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2026: exact pair counts. 2024/2025: per sample the files give the number of positive plants per target (a, b) but not which plants, so plants positive for both lie
# between sum(max(0, a + b - n)) and sum(min(a, b)); both limits are kept and the figure draws the midpoint.
m26 <- as.matrix(stem_df[, keys]); m26[is.na(m26)] <- 0
both_counts <- function(yr, k1, k2) {
  a <- S %>% filter(year == yr)
  x <- a[[paste0("n_pos_", k1)]]; y <- a[[paste0("n_pos_", k2)]]
  if (yr == "2026") { c1 <- c2 <- sum(m26[, k1] == 1 & m26[, k2] == 1) } else { c1 <- sum(pmax(0, x + y - a$n_stems)); c2 <- sum(pmin(x, y)) }
  tibble(year = yr, N = sum(a$n_stems), A = sum(x), B = sum(y), both_min = c1, both_max = c2)
}
jac_plant <- map_dfr(levels(S$year), function(yr) {
  expand_grid(t1 = keys, t2 = keys) %>% filter(match(t1, keys) > match(t2, keys)) %>%
    mutate(res = map2(t1, t2, ~ both_counts(yr, .x, .y))) %>% unnest(res)
}) %>% mutate(j_min = both_min / (A + B - both_min), j_max = both_max / (A + B - both_max), jaccard = (j_min + j_max) / 2, exact = both_min == both_max)
write_tab(jac_plant, "T_jaccard_plant_level_by_year")

# ---- 4c. Pectobacterium x Dickeya association, plant level --------------------------------------------------------------
# Odds ratio of Dickeya spp. in plants positive vs negative for Pectobacterium spp. (GEE, one cluster per sample). 2024/2025: model fitted at both limits of the
# possible number of plants positive for both genera (equal in 2025; 13 or 14 in 2024).
assoc_rows <- function(yr, scen) {
  if (yr == "2026") {
    d <- tibble(cl = match(stem_df$sample_id, unique(stem_df$sample_id)), pec = stem_df$pectobacterium_spp, dic = stem_df$dickeya_spp)
    d$pec[is.na(d$pec)] <- 0; d$dic[is.na(d$dic)] <- 0
    return(d)
  }
  a <- S %>% filter(year == yr)
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(a)), function(i) {
    n <- a$n_stems[i]; x <- a$n_pos_pectobacterium_spp[i]; y <- a$n_pos_dickeya_spp[i]
    cc <- if (scen == "min overlap") max(0, x + y - n) else min(x, y)
    k <- c(cc, x - cc, y - cc, n - x - y + cc)
    tibble(cl = i, pec = rep(c(1L, 1L, 0L, 0L), k), dic = rep(c(1L, 0L, 1L, 0L), k))
  })
}
assoc_one <- function(yr, scen) {
  d <- assoc_rows(yr, scen); d <- d[order(d$cl), ]
  m <- table(pec = factor(d$pec, 0:1), dic = factor(d$dic, 0:1)); ft <- fisher.test(m)
  sm <- summary(geeglm(dic ~ pec, id = cl, data = d, family = binomial, corstr = "independence"))$coefficients["pec", ]
  tibble(year = yr, overlap = if (yr == "2026") "exact" else scen, plants = nrow(d), samples = n_distinct(d$cl),
         pec_pos_dic_pos = m[2, 2], pec_pos_dic_neg = m[2, 1], pec_neg_dic_pos = m[1, 2], pec_neg_dic_neg = m[1, 1],
         or = exp(sm$Estimate), lo = exp(sm$Estimate - 1.96 * sm$Std.err), hi = exp(sm$Estimate + 1.96 * sm$Std.err), p = sm[["Pr(>|W|)"]],
         fisher_or = unname(ft$estimate), fisher_p = ft$p.value)
}
assoc_plant <- bind_rows(assoc_one("2024", "min overlap"), assoc_one("2024", "max overlap"), assoc_one("2025", "min overlap"), assoc_one("2025", "max overlap"), assoc_one("2026", "exact"))
write_tab(assoc_plant, "T_pectobacterium_x_dickeya_association_plant_level_by_year")
print(as.data.frame(assoc_plant))
cls_plant <- map_dfr(levels(S$year), function(yr) {
  b <- both_counts(yr, "pectobacterium_spp", "dickeya_spp")
  tibble(year = yr, class = c("Pectobacterium only", "Both genera", "Dickeya only", "Neither"), N = b$N,
         n_min = c(b$A - b$both_max, b$both_min, b$B - b$both_max, b$N - b$A - b$B + b$both_min),
         n_max = c(b$A - b$both_min, b$both_max, b$B - b$both_min, b$N - b$A - b$B + b$both_max))
}) %>% mutate(n = (n_min + n_max) / 2, pct = 100 * n / N, pct_min = 100 * n_min / N, pct_max = 100 * n_max / N)
write_tab(cls_plant, "T_genus_cooccurrence_classes_plant_level_by_year")
```
## Variety (2025 and 2026)

Varieties with at least five samples. Plant level (primary): Rao-Scott corrected chi-square test for clustered data (`survey::svychisq`), BH-adjusted over the four targets. Sample level (sensitivity): Fisher exact test.

```{r stats-variety}
# ---- 5. variety (2025-2026 only) --------------------------------------------------------
V <- S %>% filter(year != "2024", !is.na(variety)) %>%
  mutate(variety = recode(variety, `Russett Burbank` = "Russet Burbank", Burbank = "Russet Burbank", Altura = "Alturas", Cheiftain = "Chieftain"))
var_tab_sample <- summ_prev(V, c("variety"), "any")
write_tab(var_tab_sample, "T_prevalence_by_variety_2025_2026")
var_test_sample <- map_dfr(keys, function(k) {
  vs <- V %>% count(variety) %>% filter(n >= 5) %>% pull(variety)
  d <- V %>% filter(variety %in% vs); m <- table(d$variety, d[[paste0("any_", k)]])
  tibble(target = k, n_varieties = length(vs), n_samples = nrow(d), p = fisher.test(m, workspace = 2e8)$p.value)
}) %>% mutate(p_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH"))
write_tab(var_test_sample, "T_tests_variety_2025_2026_n5plus")

# plant level (primary)
var_tab <- summ_plant(V, "variety")
write_tab(var_tab, "T_prevalence_by_variety_plant_level_2025_2026")
var_test <- map_dfr(keys, function(k) {
  vs <- V %>% count(variety) %>% filter(n >= 5) %>% pull(variety)
  d <- plant_rows(V %>% filter(variety %in% vs), k) %>% mutate(variety = factor(variety))
  des <- survey::svydesign(ids = ~cl, data = d, weights = ~1)
  tibble(target = k, n_varieties = length(vs), n_samples = n_distinct(d$cl), n_plants = nrow(d),
         test = "Rao-Scott corrected F (clustered plants)", p = survey::svychisq(~y + variety, des, statistic = "F")$p.value)
}) %>% mutate(p_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH"))
write_tab(var_test, "T_tests_variety_plant_level_2025_2026_n5plus")
```
## Detection probability and stems per sample

Probability that at least one of k stems is positive, $1-(1-p)^k$, with p the plant-level positivity of each season and target. The probabilities assume independent plants.

```{r stats-detection}
# ---- 6. detection probability vs stems tested ----------------------------------------------
dp <- expand_grid(prev_plant %>% select(year, target, pct), k = 1:6) %>%
  mutate(p_detect = 100 * (1 - (1 - pct / 100)^k), target_lab = factor(targets[target], levels = targets))
write_tab(dp, "T_detection_probability_vs_stems")
stems_per <- S %>% count(year, n_stems) %>% group_by(year) %>% mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n))
write_tab(stems_per, "T_stems_per_sample_by_year")
```


## Environmental surveillance


```{r stats-environmental}
# ---- 7. environmental surveillance --------------------------------------------------------------
E <- env_sites %>% mutate(year = factor(year, 2025:2026))
env_site <- map_dfr(keys, function(k) {
  E %>% group_by(sample_type, year) %>%
    summarise(target = k, n = n(), pos = sum(.data[[paste0("any_", k)]]), .groups = "drop")
}) %>% mutate(unit = "site (any replicate positive)")
env_rep <- map_dfr(keys, function(k) {
  E %>% group_by(sample_type, year) %>%
    summarise(target = k, n = sum(n_tests), pos = sum(.data[[paste0("n_pos_", k)]]), .groups = "drop")
}) %>% mutate(unit = "replicate test")
env_prev <- bind_rows(env_site, env_rep)
ci <- t(mapply(cp_prop, env_prev$pos, env_prev$n))
env_prev <- env_prev %>% mutate(pct = 100 * pos / n, lo = 100 * ci[, 1], hi = 100 * ci[, 2],
                                target_lab = factor(targets[target], levels = targets))
write_tab(env_prev, "T_environmental_prevalence")
env_eff <- E %>% count(sample_type, year, region, name = "sites") %>% left_join(
  E %>% group_by(sample_type, year, region) %>% summarise(tests = sum(n_tests), .groups = "drop"), by = c("sample_type", "year", "region"))
write_tab(env_eff, "T_environmental_sampling_effort")
env_cmp <- map_dfr(c("pectobacterium_spp", "p_atrosepticum", "dickeya_spp"), function(k) {
  d <- E %>% filter(!is.na(sample_type)); m <- table(d$sample_type, d[[paste0("any_", k)]])
  tibble(target = k, air_pos = m["Air", "1"], air_n = sum(m["Air", ]), water_pos = m["Water", "1"], water_n = sum(m["Water", ]),
         p_fisher_air_vs_water = fisher.test(m)$p.value)
})
write_tab(env_cmp, "T_environmental_air_vs_water_site_level")
# plants vs water vs air in Gallatin Valley (plants, and sites for the environment; seasons pooled)
gv_stem <- SR %>% filter(region == "Gallatin Valley", year != "2024") %>% summarise(across(all_of(anyc), sum), n = n())
write_tab(gv_stem, "T_gallatin_stem_2025_2026_for_comparison")
gv_plants <- SR %>% filter(region == "Gallatin Valley", year != "2024") %>% summarise(samples = n(), plants = sum(n_stems), across(all_of(npc), sum))
write_tab(gv_plants, "T_gallatin_plants_2025_2026_for_comparison")
```

# Table 1 and the sample summary figure

Plants tested (one stem per plant) are the unit for prevalence, with SRP-positive and SRP-negative plants beneath (positive: at least one of the four targets detected). Irrigation water and air are counted as samples; the positive and negative sites beneath have at least one replicate positive (or none) for any target. All numbers are computed from the data, except that every air site was visited twice (`air_visits_per_site`, a lab record), so air samples = 2 x sites.

```{r table1}
# One number is a lab record, not a column of a data file (everything else below is computed from the data):
air_visits_per_site <- 2   # every air site was visited twice, so the air samples are 2 x the number of sites

yrs <- c("2024", "2025", "2026")
plant_n <- S %>% group_by(year = as.character(year)) %>% summarise(samples = n(), plants = sum(n_stems), .groups = "drop")
env_n   <- E %>% group_by(sample_type, year = as.character(year)) %>% summarise(sites = n(), samples = sum(n_tests), .groups = "drop")
# SRP-positive sites: at least one replicate positive for at least one target (as Figure 1B). The unit is the site because the air files list more test rows than samples (two visits per site); test rows and their positives are kept in the same table.
env_pos <- E %>% mutate(srp = (any_pectobacterium_spp + any_p_atrosepticum + any_dickeya_spp + any_d_dianthicola) > 0) %>%
  group_by(sample_type, year = as.character(year)) %>% summarise(sites = n(), positive_sites = sum(srp), negative_sites = n() - sum(srp), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(env_raw %>% mutate(srp = rowSums(across(all_of(detect_cols)) == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
              group_by(sample_type, year = as.character(year)) %>% summarise(test_rows = n(), positive_test_rows = sum(srp), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("sample_type", "year"))
stopifnot(all(env_pos$positive_sites + env_pos$negative_sites == env_pos$sites))
write_tab(env_pos, "T_srp_positive_environmental_sites")
print(as.data.frame(env_pos))

# SRP-positive plants: at least one of the four targets detected. 2026 is exact; for 2024/2025 the count lies between the largest per-target count and min(plants tested, sum of the four counts). Table 1 uses the minimum; the range is in T_srp_positive_plants_bounds.csv.
npm   <- as.matrix(S[npc])
srp_s <- S %>% transmute(year = as.character(year), sample_id, n_stems, across(all_of(npc)), min_positive = apply(npm, 1, max), max_positive = pmin(n_stems, rowSums(npm)))
m26 <- as.matrix(stem_df[, keys]); m26[is.na(m26)] <- 0
pos26 <- sum(rowSums(m26 == 1) > 0)
stopifnot(nrow(m26) == plant_n$plants[plant_n$year == "2026"])
srp_tab <- srp_s %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(plants = sum(n_stems), min_positive = sum(min_positive), max_positive = sum(max_positive), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(min_positive = ifelse(year == "2026", pos26, min_positive), max_positive = ifelse(year == "2026", pos26, max_positive),
         exact = min_positive == max_positive, min_negative = plants - max_positive, max_negative = plants - min_positive)
stopifnot(all(srp_tab$min_positive <= srp_tab$max_positive), pos26 >= sum(srp_s$min_positive[srp_s$year == "2026"]), pos26 <= sum(srp_s$max_positive[srp_s$year == "2026"]))
write_tab(srp_tab, "T_srp_positive_plants_bounds")
write_tab(srp_s %>% filter(year != "2026", min_positive != max_positive), "T_srp_positive_plants_ambiguous_samples")
print(as.data.frame(srp_tab))

fmt_tot <- function(v) c(as.character(v), as.character(sum(v)))
env_cells <- function(type) {
  d <- env_n %>% filter(sample_type == type)
  n <- setNames(d$sites, d$year)
  s <- setNames(if (type == "Air") d$sites * air_visits_per_site else d$samples, d$year)
  c(vapply(yrs, function(y) if (y %in% names(s)) sprintf("%d (%d)", s[[y]], n[[y]]) else "-", character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE),
    sprintf("%d (%d)", sum(s), sum(n)))
}
air_n <- env_n %>% filter(sample_type == "Air")
cat(sprintf("Air %s: %d test rows in the air file, %d sites; Table 1 counts %d samples (%d visits per site).\n",
            air_n$year, air_n$samples, air_n$sites, air_n$sites * air_visits_per_site, air_visits_per_site), sep = "")

env_site_cells <- function(type, col) {
  d <- env_pos %>% filter(sample_type == type); v <- setNames(d[[col]], d$year)
  c(vapply(yrs, function(y) if (y %in% names(v)) as.character(v[[y]]) else "-", character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE), as.character(sum(v)))
}
pl <- plant_n[match(yrs, plant_n$year), ]; sr <- srp_tab[match(yrs, srp_tab$year), ]
col_i <- function(i) c(fmt_tot(pl$plants)[i], fmt_tot(sr$min_positive)[i], fmt_tot(pl$plants - sr$min_positive)[i],
                       env_cells("Water")[i], env_site_cells("Water", "positive_sites")[i], env_site_cells("Water", "negative_sites")[i],
                       env_cells("Air")[i], env_site_cells("Air", "positive_sites")[i], env_site_cells("Air", "negative_sites")[i])
t1 <- tibble(
  Item = c("Plants tested", "Positive (SRP)", "Negative (SRP)", "Irrigation water: samples (sites)", "Irrigation water: positive sites (SRP)", "Irrigation water: negative sites (SRP)",
           "Air: samples (sites)", "Air: positive sites (SRP)", "Air: negative sites (SRP)"),
  `2024` = col_i(1), `2025` = col_i(2), `2026` = col_i(3), Total = col_i(4)
)
write_tab(t1, "T1_sample_summary")
kable(t1, align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"), caption = "Table 1. Plants tested, environmental samples and SRP-positive and SRP-negative plants and sites, by season")
```
Table 1 drawn as a figure from `t1` (no title, white background, season colours as in Figure 1).

```{r fig-sample-summary, fig.keep='none'}
# Sample summary drawn as a table in the figure style
en <- intToUtf8(0x2013); ge <- intToUtf8(0x2265)   # built here so the code stays ASCII
f <- t1
item_lab <- c("Plants tested", "Positive (SRP)", "Negative (SRP)", "Irrigation water, samples (sites)", "Positive sites (SRP)", "Negative sites (SRP)",
              "Air, samples (sites)", "Positive sites (SRP)", "Negative sites (SRP)")
item_grp <- c("Plant", "Plant", "Plant", rep("Environment", 6))
item_ind <- c(0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1)   # the positive and negative rows are indented under the plants tested, the water row and the air row

# row positions: a header row at y = 0, then one heading per group followed by its rows
lay <- list(); y <- -1.5
for (g in unique(item_grp)) {
  lay[[length(lay) + 1]] <- tibble(kind = "group", label = g, y = y, idx = NA_integer_, ind = 0); y <- y - 1
  for (k in which(item_grp == g)) { lay[[length(lay) + 1]] <- tibble(kind = "item", label = item_lab[k], y = y, idx = k, ind = item_ind[k]); y <- y - 1 }
  y <- y - .3
}
lay <- bind_rows(lay); y_bot <- min(lay$y) - .65
xcol <- c("2024" = 3.3, "2025" = 4.3, "2026" = 5.3, Total = 6.8)
x_sep <- 6.05; x_end <- 7.45

cells <- lay %>% filter(kind == "item") %>%
  crossing(col = names(xcol)) %>%
  mutate(txt = map2_chr(idx, col, ~ f[[.y]][.x]),
         word = txt %in% c("to be sent", "pending"),
         txt = ifelse(txt == "-", en, txt),
         x = xcol[col])

fig_samples <- ggplot() +
  # column headings: one season colour per column, plain "Total" at the right
  geom_text(data = tibble(col = names(xcol), x = xcol), aes(x, 0, label = col, colour = col), fontface = "bold", size = 4.1 * font_scale, family = fam) +
  geom_segment(data = tibble(col = names(xcol), x = xcol), aes(x = x - .42, xend = x + .42, y = -.55, yend = -.55, colour = col), linewidth = 1.1, lineend = "butt") +
  # group headings with a thin rule
  geom_text(data = lay %>% filter(kind == "group"), aes(0, y, label = label), hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam) +
  geom_segment(data = lay %>% filter(kind == "group"), aes(x = 0, xend = x_end, y = y - .5, yend = y - .5), linewidth = .3, colour = ink3) +
  # rows
  geom_text(data = lay %>% filter(kind == "item"), aes(.12 + .3 * ind, y, label = label), hjust = 0, size = 3.25 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam) +
  geom_text(data = cells %>% filter(!word & txt != en), aes(x, y, label = txt), size = 3.5 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam) +
  geom_text(data = cells %>% filter(txt == en), aes(x, y, label = txt), size = 3.5 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam) +
  geom_text(data = cells %>% filter(word), aes(x, y, label = txt), size = 3.1 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, fontface = "italic", family = fam) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x_sep, xend = x_sep, y = .4, yend = y_bot + .15), linewidth = .3, colour = ink3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(yr_col, Total = ink_t), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-.05, x_end + .05), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_bot, .6), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_void(base_family = fam) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA), plot.margin = margin(4, 6, 4, 6))
save_ms(fig_samples, "Fig_sample_summary", 6.9, round(3.55 * (.6 - y_bot) / 13.35, 2))   # same row height as before the isolate rows were removed
show_fig("Fig_sample_summary")
```
# Table 2 as a figure: isolate source, qPCR identification and pitting

The 53 isolates of Table 2, one column each, in two blocks (isolate-code order). Rows: source (P plant, W irrigation water, A air), qPCR identification (Pe *Pectobacterium* spp., Pa *P. atrosepticum*, Dk *Dickeya* spp., Dd *D. dianthicola*, nd no target detected, nt not tested) and pitting on CVP agar (n.t. not tested). Codes of isolates tested for pitting are bold, coloured and underlined. Input: `Table2_isolate_source_qpcr_pitting.csv` (figure skipped when absent).

```{r fig-isolate-table2, fig.keep='none'}
# Table 2 (isolate source, qPCR identification, pitting) as a figure; input Table2_isolate_source_qpcr_pitting.csv (optional).
t2_path <- file.path(data_dir, "Table2_isolate_source_qpcr_pitting.csv")
if (!file.exists(t2_path)) {
  cat("Table2_isolate_source_qpcr_pitting.csv is not in the data folder: the isolate source / qPCR / pitting figure is skipped.\n")
} else {
  t2 <- readr::read_csv(t2_path, col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), str_trim))
  stopifnot("Table2 csv needs the columns isolate_code, source, qpcr_id, pitting" = all(c("isolate_code", "source", "qpcr_id", "pitting") %in% names(t2)),
            "duplicate isolate codes in the Table2 csv" = !anyDuplicated(t2$isolate_code))
  src_lev <- c("Plant", "Irrigation water", "Air")
  qp_lev  <- c("Pectobacterium spp.", "P. atrosepticum", "Dickeya spp.", "D. dianthicola", "No target detected", "Not tested")
  stopifnot("unknown source in the Table2 csv" = all(t2$source %in% src_lev), "unknown qPCR ID in the Table2 csv" = all(t2$qpcr_id %in% qp_lev),
            "pitting must be -, +, ++, +++ or n.t." = all(t2$pitting %in% c(pit_levels, "n.t.")))

  # Check against the workbooks: qPCR identification from the 0/1 flags of ani_pathogenicity.xlsx, pitting from ani_pitting.xlsx (the source column is not compared).
  flag_cols <- c("D. dianthicola", "P. atrosepticum", "Dickeya spp.", "Pectobacterium spp.")
  if (all(flag_cols %in% names(raw_isolates))) {
    wb <- raw_isolates %>% transmute(isolate_code = `Isolate code`, dd = `D. dianthicola`, pa = `P. atrosepticum`, dk = `Dickeya spp.`, pe = `Pectobacterium spp.`) %>%
      mutate(qpcr_wb = case_when(is.na(dd) & is.na(pa) & is.na(dk) & is.na(pe) ~ "Not tested", dd %in% 1 ~ "D. dianthicola", pa %in% 1 ~ "P. atrosepticum",
                                 dk %in% 1 ~ "Dickeya spp.", pe %in% 1 ~ "Pectobacterium spp.", TRUE ~ "No target detected")) %>%
      left_join(isolates %>% select(isolate_code, pit_chr), by = "isolate_code") %>% mutate(pit_wb = ifelse(is.na(pit_chr), "n.t.", pit_chr))
    t2_diff <- t2 %>% inner_join(wb %>% select(isolate_code, qpcr_wb, pit_wb), by = "isolate_code") %>% filter(qpcr_id != qpcr_wb | pitting != pit_wb)
    save_table(t2_diff, "T_table2_vs_workbooks_discrepancies")
    cat(sprintf("Table 2: %d isolates (%d in the workbooks); qPCR ID or pitting differs from the workbooks for %d.\n", nrow(t2), sum(t2$isolate_code %in% wb$isolate_code), nrow(t2_diff)))
  }
  write_tab(t2, "T2_isolate_source_qpcr_pitting")

  # ---- drawing: isolates are columns, in two stacked blocks; rows are source, qPCR ID and pitting ----
  src_cols <- c(Plant = "#cfe7da", `Irrigation water` = "#cfe0f5", Air = "#f5e3c4"); src_code <- c(Plant = "P", `Irrigation water` = "W", Air = "A")
  qp_cols  <- setNames(c("#a79de0", "#4a3aa7", "#f6d27a", "#eda100", "#cfcec8", "#f4f3ef"), qp_lev)
  qp_code  <- setNames(c("Pe", "Pa", "Dk", "Dd", "nd", "nt"), qp_lev)
  qp_txt   <- setNames(c(ink_t, "white", ink_t, ink_t, ink_t, ink_t), qp_lev)
  pit_key  <- c(pit_levels, "not tested"); pit_txt <- setNames(c(ink_t, ink_t, "white", "white", ink_t), pit_key)
  pit_show <- setNames(c(minus, "+", "++", "+++", "n.t."), pit_key)

  t2 <- t2 %>% arrange(isolate_code) %>%
    mutate(pit = ifelse(pitting == "n.t.", "not tested", pitting), blk = ifelse(row_number() <= ceiling(n() / 2), 1, 2))
  t2 <- t2 %>% group_by(blk) %>% mutate(x = row_number()) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(off = ifelse(blk == 1, 0, -6.2))
  tiles <- bind_rows(
    t2 %>% transmute(x, y = 3 + off, fill = unname(src_cols[source]),  lab = unname(src_code[source]),  txt = ink_t),
    t2 %>% transmute(x, y = 2 + off, fill = unname(qp_cols[qpcr_id]), lab = unname(qp_code[qpcr_id]), txt = unname(qp_txt[qpcr_id])),
    t2 %>% transmute(x, y = 1 + off, fill = unname(pit_cols[pit]),     lab = unname(pit_show[pit]),    txt = unname(pit_txt[pit])))
  heads <- t2 %>% transmute(x, y = 3.75 + off, lab = isolate_code, tested = pitting != "n.t.")   # tested for pitting on CVP agar: bold and coloured
  mark_col <- "#b4301c"; n_tested <- sum(heads$tested); n_not_tested <- sum(!heads$tested)
  rlab  <- tibble(y = c(3, 2, 1, 3 - 6.2, 2 - 6.2, 1 - 6.2), lab = rep(c("Source", "qPCR ID", "Pitting on CVP agar"), 2))

  # legend rows (tile with its code, then the name and the number of isolates); positions follow the label lengths
  leg_row <- function(y, labs, codes, fills, txts, ns, x0 = 1) {
    w <- 1.25 + 0.215 * font_scale * (nchar(labs) + nchar(ns) + 3) + 0.9; x <- x0 + c(0, head(cumsum(w), -1))
    list(tile = tibble(x = x, y = y, fill = fills, lab = codes, txt = txts), txt = tibble(x = x + 0.8, y = y, lab = sprintf("%s (%s)", labs, ns)))
  }
  cnt <- function(v, lev) as.character(table(factor(v, lev)))
  lg <- list(
    leg_row(-8.6,  src_lev, unname(src_code), unname(src_cols), rep(ink_t, 3), cnt(t2$source, src_lev)),
    leg_row(-9.9,  qp_lev[1:3], unname(qp_code[1:3]), unname(qp_cols[1:3]), unname(qp_txt[1:3]), cnt(t2$qpcr_id, qp_lev)[1:3]),
    leg_row(-11.2, qp_lev[4:6], unname(qp_code[4:6]), unname(qp_cols[4:6]), unname(qp_txt[4:6]), cnt(t2$qpcr_id, qp_lev)[4:6]),
    leg_row(-12.5, c(minus, "+", "++", "+++", "not tested"), unname(pit_show), unname(pit_cols[pit_key]), unname(pit_txt), cnt(t2$pit, pit_key)))
  lg_names <- tibble(y = c(-8.6, -9.9, -12.5), lab = c("Source", "qPCR ID", "Pitting on CVP agar"))
  tiles <- bind_rows(tiles, map_dfr(lg, "tile")); lg_txt <- map_dfr(lg, "txt")

  xl <- c(-7.6, 28.2); yl <- c(-14.7, 5.0)
  fig_t2 <- ggplot() +
    geom_tile(data = tiles, aes(x, y, fill = fill), width = .92, height = .92, colour = "#dcdbd6", linewidth = .15) +
    geom_text(data = tiles, aes(x, y, label = lab, colour = txt), size = 2.15 * font_scale, family = fam) +
    geom_text(data = heads %>% filter(!tested), aes(x, y, label = lab), angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = .5, size = 2.25 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, fontface = "plain", family = fam) +
    geom_segment(data = heads %>% filter(tested), aes(x = x + 0.27, xend = x + 0.27, y = y, yend = y + 1.04), linewidth = .5, colour = mark_col, lineend = "butt") +
    geom_text(data = heads %>% filter(tested), aes(x, y, label = lab), angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = .5, size = 2.25 * font_scale, colour = mark_col, fontface = "bold", family = fam) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.2, y = -13.8, label = "Isolate code", hjust = 1, size = 2.5 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, fontface = "bold", family = fam) +
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = -13.8, label = "PI019", hjust = 0, size = 2.5 * font_scale, colour = mark_col, fontface = "bold", family = fam) +
    annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2.5, y = -14.07, yend = -14.07, linewidth = .55, colour = mark_col, lineend = "butt") +
    annotate("text", x = 2.9, y = -13.8, label = sprintf("tested for pitting on CVP agar (%d)", n_tested), hjust = 0, size = 2.5 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam) +
    annotate("text", x = 13.2, y = -13.8, label = "PI005", hjust = 0, size = 2.5 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, fontface = "plain", family = fam) +
    annotate("text", x = 15.1, y = -13.8, label = sprintf("not tested (%d)", n_not_tested), hjust = 0, size = 2.5 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam) +
    geom_text(data = rlab, aes(0.2, y, label = lab), hjust = 1, size = 2.5 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, fontface = "bold", family = fam) +
    geom_text(data = lg_names, aes(0.2, y, label = lab), hjust = 1, size = 2.5 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, fontface = "bold", family = fam) +
    geom_text(data = lg_txt, aes(x, y, label = lab), hjust = 0, size = 2.5 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam) +
    scale_fill_identity() + scale_colour_identity() +
    coord_fixed(xlim = xl, ylim = yl, expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_family = fam) + theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA), plot.margin = margin(4, 6, 4, 6))
  w_in <- 8.1
  save_ms(fig_t2, "Fig_isolate_source_qpcr_pitting", w_in, w_in * diff(yl) / diff(xl) + 0.15)
  show_fig("Fig_isolate_source_qpcr_pitting")
}
```
# Table 4 as a figure: ANI, assigned taxonomy and source of the isolates

The 36 isolates with an ANI-based identification, grouped by assigned taxonomy (n in brackets). Columns: isolate code, source, ANI to the best-matching reference (circle 95% or more, triangle below 95%, dashed line at 95%) and the ANI value. Input: `Table4_isolate_ani_taxonomy_source.csv` (figure skipped when absent).

```{r fig-isolate-table4, fig.keep='none'}
# Table 4 (ANI, assigned taxonomy, source) as a figure; input Table4_isolate_ani_taxonomy_source.csv (optional).
t4_path <- file.path(data_dir, "Table4_isolate_ani_taxonomy_source.csv")
if (!file.exists(t4_path)) {
  cat("Table4_isolate_ani_taxonomy_source.csv is not in the data folder: the isolate ANI / taxonomy / source figure is skipped.\n")
} else {
  t4 <- readr::read_csv(t4_path, col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), str_trim), ani = as.numeric(ani))
  src_lev <- c("Plant", "Irrigation water", "Air")
  stopifnot("Table4 csv needs the columns isolate_code, ani, taxonomy, source" = all(c("isolate_code", "ani", "taxonomy", "source") %in% names(t4)),
            "duplicate isolate codes in the Table4 csv" = !anyDuplicated(t4$isolate_code), "ANI must be a number" = !anyNA(t4$ani),
            "unknown source in the Table4 csv" = all(t4$source %in% src_lev))

  # Check against the isolate workbook: same isolates (numeric ANI), same ANI (two decimals) and taxonomy; source is compared with Table 2 when present.
  wb <- isolates %>% filter(!is.na(ani_numeric)) %>% select(isolate_code, ani_wb = ani_numeric, tax_wb = id_ani)
  t4_diff <- t4 %>% full_join(wb, by = "isolate_code") %>%
    filter(is.na(ani) | is.na(ani_wb) | abs(ani - ani_wb) > 0.011 | taxonomy != tax_wb)
  t2_path_chk <- file.path(data_dir, "Table2_isolate_source_qpcr_pitting.csv")
  n_src_diff <- NA_integer_
  if (file.exists(t2_path_chk)) {
    t2_src <- readr::read_csv(t2_path_chk, col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% select(isolate_code, source_t2 = source)
    n_src_diff <- nrow(t4 %>% inner_join(t2_src, by = "isolate_code") %>% filter(source != source_t2))
  }
  save_table(t4_diff, "T_table4_vs_workbook_discrepancies")
  cat(sprintf("Table 4: %d isolates (%d with a numeric ANI in the workbook); ANI or taxonomy differs from the workbook for %d; source differs from Table 2 for %s; ANI of 95%% or more: %d.\n",
              nrow(t4), nrow(wb), nrow(t4_diff), ifelse(is.na(n_src_diff), "n/a (Table 2 file absent)", as.character(n_src_diff)), sum(t4$ani >= 95)))
  write_tab(t4, "T4_isolate_ani_taxonomy_source")

  # ---- drawing: one row per isolate, grouped by assigned taxonomy ----
  gen_pal4 <- c(Pectobacterium = "#4a3aa7", Dickeya = "#eda100")
  src_cols <- c(Plant = "#cfe7da", `Irrigation water` = "#cfe0f5", Air = "#f5e3c4"); src_code <- c(Plant = "Plant", `Irrigation water` = "Water", Air = "Air")
  abbr <- function(x) sub("^(.)[a-z]+ ", "\\1. ", x)
  grp_tab <- t4 %>% count(taxonomy, name = "n") %>% mutate(genus = sub(" .*", "", taxonomy)) %>%
    arrange(factor(genus, c("Pectobacterium", "Dickeya")), desc(n), taxonomy) %>%
    mutate(grp = factor(sprintf("<i>%s</i> (%d)", abbr(taxonomy), n), sprintf("<i>%s</i> (%d)", abbr(taxonomy), n)))
  d4 <- t4 %>% left_join(grp_tab %>% select(taxonomy, genus, grp), by = "taxonomy") %>%
    mutate(tier = factor(ifelse(ani >= 95, tier_hi, tier_lo), c(tier_hi, tier_lo)), genus = factor(genus, c("Pectobacterium", "Dickeya"))) %>%
    arrange(grp, desc(ani)) %>% mutate(code_f = factor(isolate_code, rev(isolate_code)))
  x_src <- 75.55; x_val <- 101.6
  fig_t4 <- ggplot(d4, aes(y = code_f)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 95, linewidth = .4, colour = ink3, linetype = "22") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 77.6, xend = ani, yend = code_f), colour = "#e3e2dd", linewidth = .35) +
    purrr::map(src_lev, function(s) geom_tile(data = d4 %>% filter(source == s), aes(x = x_src), width = 2.7, height = .82, fill = unname(src_cols[s]), colour = "#dcdbd6", linewidth = .15)) +
    geom_text(aes(x = x_src, label = unname(src_code[source])), size = 2.0 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam) +
    geom_point(aes(x = ani, fill = genus, shape = tier), size = 2.5, colour = ink, stroke = .45) +
    geom_text(aes(x = x_val, label = sprintf("%.2f", ani)), hjust = 0, size = 2.35 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam) +
    geom_text(data = d4 %>% filter(grp == levels(d4$grp)[nlevels(d4$grp)]), aes(x = 94.4, label = "95% species-level threshold"),
              hjust = 1, size = 2.45 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam) +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(grp), scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = gen_pal4, name = "Genus (provisional)", aesthetics = "fill", guide = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 2.8))) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = setNames(c(21, 24), c(tier_hi, tier_lo)), labels = sub("^ANI ", "", c(tier_hi, tier_lo)), name = "ANI", guide = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(fill = "grey70", size = 2.8))) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(80, 100, 5)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(74.2, 100.6), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
    labs(x = "ANI to the best-matching reference genome (%)", y = NULL) + theme_ms(9) +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left", legend.box = "vertical", legend.box.just = "left", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "pt"), legend.box.spacing = unit(2, "pt"),
          axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 6.8 * font_scale, colour = ink_t), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank(), strip.placement = "outside", strip.text.y.left = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 7.6 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, face = "plain"),
          panel.spacing.y = unit(4, "pt"), plot.margin = margin(4, 44, 4, 4))
  save_ms(fig_t4, "Fig_isolate_ani_taxonomy", 6.8, 7.1)
  show_fig("Fig_isolate_ani_taxonomy")
}
```
# Main figures

Each chunk builds the plot, saves PNG, PDF and SVG to `figures/` and displays the PNG.

## Figure 1. Prevalence in plant and environmental samples, by season

\(A) Plants tested positive for each target, 2024-2026. (B) Environmental sites (air, irrigation water) positive for each target, 2025-2026. Labels give the percentage and, in brackets, positives/tested; the number under each bar is the number tested. No confidence intervals are drawn (5 to 8 sites per environmental bar); intervals are in `T_prevalence_plant_level_by_year.csv` and `T_environmental_prevalence.csv`, season contrasts in `T_tests_pairwise_plant_level_GEE.csv`, plotted values in `T_fig1_prevalence_plant_environment.csv`.

```{r fig1, fig.keep='none'}
# ---- Figure 1: (A) positive plants, 2024-2026; (B) positive environmental sites (air, irrigation water), 2025-2026 -----------
target_md2 <- c(pectobacterium_spp = "<i>Pectobacterium</i><br>spp.", p_atrosepticum = "<i>P.<br>atrosepticum</i>",
                dickeya_spp = "<i>Dickeya</i><br>spp.", d_dianthicola = "<i>D.<br>dianthicola</i>")
pv <- D$prev_plant %>% transmute(target = tgt_fac(target), year = as.character(year), pct, n, pos, strip = "Plant")
ev <- D$env_prev %>% filter(unit == "site (any replicate positive)") %>%
  transmute(target = tgt_fac(target), year = as.character(year), pct, n, pos, strip = recode(sample_type, Water = "Irrigation water")) %>%
  mutate(strip = factor(strip, c("Air", "Irrigation water")))
write_tab(bind_rows(pv, ev %>% mutate(strip = as.character(strip))) %>%
            transmute(target = as.character(target), sample_type = strip, year, n_positive = pos, positive_pct = pct, n_plants_or_sites = n),
          "T_fig1_prevalence_plant_environment")

fig1_panel <- function(d, ylab) {
  ggplot(d, aes(target, pct, fill = year)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = .4, colour = ink2) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(.8), width = .74, colour = "white", linewidth = .3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = pct_lab(pct)), position = position_dodge(.8), vjust = -1.55, size = 2.7 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam) +   # percentage
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0("(", pos, "/", n, ")")), position = position_dodge(.8), vjust = -.45, size = 2.3 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam) +   # positives / tested
    geom_text(aes(y = -3, label = n), position = position_dodge(.8), vjust = 1, size = 2.3 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam) +
    facet_wrap(~strip, nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = yr_col, limits = names(yr_col), name = "Season") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) unname(target_md2[x])) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-11, 112), clip = "off") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    theme_ms(10) + theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
                         axis.line.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_markdown(size = 8.5 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, lineheight = 1))
}
p1A <- fig1_panel(pv, "Plants positive (%)")
p1B <- fig1_panel(ev, "Sites positive (%)") + guides(fill = "none") +   # the season legend comes from panel A only
  geom_text(data = tibble(strip = factor("Air", c("Air", "Irrigation water")), target = factor("pectobacterium_spp", keys)), aes(x = target, y = 111, label = "No environmental\nsampling in 2024"),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 1, size = 2.4 * font_scale, lineheight = .95, colour = ink_t, family = fam, fontface = "italic")
fig1 <- (p1A / p1B) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag.position = c(0, 1), legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left")
save_ms(fig1, "Fig1_prevalence_plant_environment", 9, 8.2)

show_fig("Fig1_prevalence_plant_environment")
```
## Figures 2 and 3. Prevalence by seed generation and by region

Percentage of plants tested positive for each target by seed generation (Figure 2) and by region (Figure 3), per season. Bars are faded where fewer than five plants were tested; the number under each bar is the number of plants tested.

```{r fig2-3-function}
grouped_fig <- function(tab, catvar, cat_levels, cat_labs, xlab, w, h, name) {
  d <- tab %>% mutate(cat = factor(.data[[catvar]], levels = cat_levels, labels = cat_labs),
                      target = tgt_fac(target), year = factor(year, levels = 2024:2026)) %>%
    complete(cat, year, target)
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(cat, pct, fill = year, alpha = !is.na(n) & n < 5)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = .4, colour = ink2) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(.88), width = .84, colour = "white", linewidth = .25) +
    geom_text(aes(y = pct, label = pct_num(pct)), position = position_dodge(.88), vjust = -.45, size = 2.45 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam, alpha = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(y = -3, label = n), position = position_dodge(.88), vjust = 1, size = 2.15 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam, alpha = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~target, ncol = 2, labeller = lab_target) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = yr_col, name = "Season", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 1, `TRUE` = .38), guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-11, 116), clip = "off") +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Plants positive (%)") +
    theme_ms(10) + theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
                         axis.line.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
  save_ms(p, name, w, h); p
}
```

## Figure 4. Co-occurrence of targets

\(A) Pairwise Jaccard index between targets, by season (Pec, *Pectobacterium* spp.; Pa, *P. atrosepticum*; Dic, *Dickeya* spp.; Dd, *D. dianthicola*). (B) Share of plants by genus-level detection class. 2026 values are exact (one record per plant). For 2024 and 2025 the number of plants positive for two targets is bounded; the figure draws the midpoint and, in panel A, the range where it exceeds 0.03 (limits in `T_jaccard_plant_level_by_year.csv` and `T_genus_cooccurrence_classes_plant_level_by_year.csv`). The *Pectobacterium* by *Dickeya* odds ratio is in `T_pectobacterium_x_dickeya_association_plant_level_by_year.csv`.

```{r fig4, fig.keep='none'}
short <- c(pectobacterium_spp = "Pec", p_atrosepticum = "Pa", dickeya_spp = "Dic", d_dianthicola = "Dd")
yr_n <- D$prev_plant %>% distinct(year, n) %>% mutate(lab = sprintf("%s (n = %d)", year, n)) %>% { setNames(.$lab, .$year) }
jd <- D$jac_plant %>%
  mutate(i1 = match(t1, keys), i2 = match(t2, keys)) %>% filter(i1 > i2) %>%
  mutate(x = factor(short[t2], levels = short[keys[1:3]]), y = factor(short[t1], levels = rev(short[keys[2:4]])),
         year = factor(year), ylab = yr_n[as.character(year)],
         txtcol = ifelse(jaccard > .5, "white", ink_t),
         wide = (j_max - j_min) > .03,
         lab = ifelse(wide, sprintf("%.2f\u2013%.2f", j_min, j_max), sprintf("%.2f", jaccard)), tsz = ifelse(wide, 2.0, 3.3) * font_scale)
p4A <- ggplot(jd, aes(x, y, fill = jaccard)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = lab, colour = txtcol, size = tsz), family = fam) +
  scale_colour_identity() + scale_size_identity() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = blue_ramp, limits = c(0, 1), name = "Jaccard index", breaks = c(0, .5, 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ylab, nrow = 1) + guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = .5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + coord_fixed() +
  theme_ms(10) + theme(axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
                       legend.key.width = unit(1.6, "lines"), legend.key.height = unit(.55, "lines"))

cl <- D$cls_plant %>% mutate(class = factor(class, levels = c("Neither", "Dickeya only", "Both genera", "Pectobacterium only")),
                       ylab = factor(yr_n[as.character(year)], levels = rev(yr_n)),
                       lab = ifelse(pct >= 5, sprintf("%.0f%%", pct), ""),
                       txtcol = ifelse(class %in% c("Pectobacterium only", "Both genera"), "white", ink_t))
p4B <- ggplot(cl, aes(pct, ylab, fill = class, group = class)) +
  geom_col(width = .66, colour = "white", linewidth = .6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = lab, colour = txtcol, group = class), position = position_stack(vjust = .5), size = 3.1 * font_scale, family = fam) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gen_col, name = NULL, breaks = c("Pectobacterium only", "Both genera", "Dickeya only", "Neither"), guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .01)), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  labs(x = "Plants (%)", y = NULL) +
  theme_ms(10) + theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = "left", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
fig4 <- p4A + p4B + plot_layout(widths = c(1.55, 1)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") & theme(plot.tag.position = c(0, 1))
save_ms(fig4, "Fig4_cooccurrence_three_seasons", 12.3, 4.5)

show_fig("Fig4_cooccurrence_three_seasons")
```
## Figure 5. Prevalence by variety

Percentage of plants tested positive by variety (2025-2026; varieties with plants from at least five samples) with cluster-adjusted exact 95% confidence intervals. Number tested in brackets; dashed line, overall percentage for the target.

```{r fig5, fig.keep='none'}
V <- D$S %>% filter(year != "2024", !is.na(variety)) %>%
  mutate(variety = recode(variety, `Russett Burbank` = "Russet Burbank", Burbank = "Russet Burbank", Altura = "Alturas", Cheiftain = "Chieftain"))
vt <- D$var_tab %>% filter(samples >= 5) %>% mutate(ntot = n)
ord <- vt %>% distinct(variety, ntot) %>% arrange(ntot) %>% mutate(vlab = sprintf("%s (n = %d)", variety, ntot))

ref <- V %>% summarise(across(all_of(paste0("n_pos_", keys)), ~ 100 * sum(.) / sum(n_stems))) %>% pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "target", values_to = "ref") %>%
  mutate(target = tgt_fac(sub("n_pos_", "", target)))
p5 <- ggplot(vt, aes(pct, vlab)) +
  geom_vline(data = ref, aes(xintercept = ref), linewidth = .4, colour = ink3, linetype = "22") +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 50, 100), limits = c(-2, 102), expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
```

## Figure 6. Maps of sampled locations

\(A) Sampled locations in 2025 and 2026, coloured by the number of targets detected and sized by the number of samples. (B) The same locations coloured by detection of *Dickeya* spp. 2026 coordinates are centroids inferred from the grower's 2025 fields.

```{r fig6, fig.keep='none'}
mt   <- map_data("state", "montana"); cty <- map_data("county", "montana")
loc <- D$S %>% filter(year != "2024", !is.na(lat)) %>%
  mutate(lat = round(lat, 4), long = round(long, 4)) %>%
  group_by(year, lat, long) %>%
  summarise(n_samples = n(), across(all_of(paste0("any_", keys)), ~ as.integer(any(. == 1))), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(n_targets = any_pectobacterium_spp + any_p_atrosepticum + any_dickeya_spp + any_d_dianthicola,
         dick = factor(ifelse(any_dickeya_spp == 1, "Positive", "Negative"), c("Positive", "Negative")))
write_tab(loc %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(locations = n(), samples = sum(n_samples), dickeya_locations = sum(any_dickeya_spp)), "T_map_location_summary")
reg_lab <- tibble(x = c(-113.95, -111.75, -112.5), y = c(47.95, 46.95, 45.03), lab = c("Flathead", "Gallatin Valley", "Dillon/Twin Bridges"), hj = c(0, .5, .5))
base_map <- function() list(
  geom_polygon(data = mt, aes(long, lat, group = group), fill = "#f6f5f1", colour = ink3, linewidth = .4),
  geom_path(data = cty, aes(long, lat, group = group), colour = "#dedcd5", linewidth = .2),
  geom_text(data = reg_lab, aes(x, y, label = lab, hjust = hj), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.6 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam, fontface = "italic"),
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(-114.75, -110.6), ylim = c(44.9, 48.55)),
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-114, -112), labels = c("114\u00b0W", "112\u00b0W")),
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(45, 46, 47, 48), labels = c("45\u00b0N", "46\u00b0N", "47\u00b0N", "48\u00b0N")),
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL),
  theme_ms(9), theme(panel.spacing = unit(.5, "lines"), axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = .3))
)
p6A <- ggplot() + base_map() +
  geom_point(data = loc %>% arrange(n_targets), aes(long, lat, fill = factor(n_targets), size = n_samples), shape = 21, colour = ink2, stroke = .35, alpha = .95) +
  facet_wrap(~year, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`0` = "#cfcec8", `1` = "#cde2fb", `2` = "#86b6ef", `3` = "#256abf", `4` = "#0d366b"), name = "Targets detected\nat location", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2.2, 6.5), breaks = c(1, 5, 10), name = "Samples at\nlocation") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3.5), order = 1), size = guide_legend(order = 2))
p6B <- ggplot() + base_map() +
  geom_point(data = loc %>% arrange(desc(dick)), aes(long, lat, fill = dick, size = n_samples), shape = 21, colour = ink2, stroke = .35, alpha = .95) +
  facet_wrap(~year, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Positive = "#e34948", Negative = "#cfcec8"), name = "Dickeya spp.\ndetected") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2.2, 6.5), breaks = c(1, 5, 10), guide = "none") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3.5)))
fig6 <- p6A + p6B + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") & theme(plot.tag.position = c(0, 1))
save_ms(fig6, "Fig6_maps_locations", 12.3, 4.3)

show_fig("Fig6_maps_locations")
```

## Figure 7. Environmental surveillance (merged into Figure 1)

Not drawn: air and irrigation water are panel B of Figure 1. The Gallatin Valley comparison of plants, irrigation water sites and air sites is written to `T_gallatin_stem_water_air.csv` (exact 95% intervals).

```{r gallatin-table}
gv_stem <- D$SR %>% filter(region == "Gallatin Valley", year != "2024")
gv_env  <- D$E %>% filter(region == "Gallatin Valley")
cmp <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(keys, function(k) tibble(source = "Plants", target = k, pos = sum(gv_stem[[paste0("n_pos_", k)]]), n = sum(gv_stem$n_stems))),
  map_dfr(keys, function(k) { d <- gv_env %>% filter(sample_type == "Water"); tibble(source = "Irrigation water sites", target = k, pos = sum(d[[paste0("any_", k)]]), n = nrow(d)) }),
  map_dfr(keys, function(k) { d <- gv_env %>% filter(sample_type == "Air"); tibble(source = "Air sites", target = k, pos = sum(d[[paste0("any_", k)]]), n = nrow(d)) })
)
ci <- t(mapply(cp_pct, cmp$pos, cmp$n))
for (i in which(cmp$source == "Plants")) ci[i, ] <- 100 * cp_clust(gv_stem[[paste0("n_pos_", cmp$target[i])]], gv_stem$n_stems)[c("lo", "hi")]   # plants: cluster-adjusted interval
cmp <- cmp %>% mutate(pct = 100 * pos / n, lo = ci[, 1], hi = ci[, 2], target = tgt_fac(target),
                      source = factor(source, c("Plants", "Irrigation water sites", "Air sites")))
write_tab(cmp, "T_gallatin_stem_water_air")
print(cmp %>% mutate(across(c(pct, lo, hi), ~ round(., 1))), n = Inf)
```
## Figure 8. Isolates: species, ANI and decayed tissue weight

\(A) Decayed tissue weight by whole-genome species identity, ordered by median; colour = genus, shape = ANI tier (95% threshold). (B) Decayed tissue weight against reported ANI with the Spearman correlation. Tests (Kruskal-Wallis, Wilcoxon, Spearman) are in `T_isolate_statistics.csv`.

```{r fig8, fig.keep='none'}
iso <- D$iso %>% mutate(ani = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(wgs_ani_raw)),
                        tier = factor(ifelse(ani >= 95, tier_hi, tier_lo), c(tier_hi, tier_lo)),
                        genus = factor(genus, c("Pectobacterium", "Dickeya")))
an <- iso %>% filter(!is.na(id_ani), !is.na(decay_g))
sp_ord <- an %>% group_by(id_ani) %>% summarise(med = median(decay_g), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(med) %>%
  mutate(sp_lab = sprintf("<i>%s</i> (n = %d)", sub("^(.)[a-z]+ ", "\\1. ", id_ani), n))
an <- an %>% left_join(sp_ord %>% select(id_ani, sp_lab), by = "id_ani") %>% mutate(sp_lab = factor(sp_lab, sp_ord$sp_lab))
gen_pal <- c(Pectobacterium = "#4a3aa7", Dickeya = "#eda100")
p8A <- ggplot(an, aes(decay_g, sp_lab)) +
  geom_boxplot(data = an %>% group_by(sp_lab) %>% filter(n() >= 4), width = .5, outlier.shape = NA, colour = ink3, fill = NA, linewidth = .4) +
  stat_summary(data = an %>% group_by(sp_lab) %>% filter(n() < 4), fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = .4, colour = ink3, linewidth = .4, fatten = 0) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = genus, shape = tier), position = position_jitter(height = .13, width = 0, seed = 7), size = 2.6, colour = ink, stroke = .5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gen_pal, name = "Genus (provisional)") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = setNames(c(21, 24), c(tier_hi, tier_lo)), name = "Reported ANI") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 3)), shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey70"))) +
  labs(x = "Decayed tissue weight (g)", y = NULL) + theme_ms(10) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.box = "vertical", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "pt"))
rho <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(an$ani, an$decay_g, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
kw  <- kruskal.test(decay_g ~ id_ani, data = an)
wg  <- wilcox.test(decay_g ~ genus, data = an)  # exact (no ties)
hi  <- an %>% filter(ani >= 95); lo <- an %>% filter(ani < 95)
wt  <- wilcox.test(hi$decay_g, lo$decay_g)  # exact (no ties)
pv_ver <- an %>% filter(id_ani == "Pectobacterium versatile", ani >= 95)
iso_stats <- tibble(
  stat = c("n isolates in sheet", "n with ANI-based ID", "n outlier assemblies", "n with decay weight", "n analysis set (ID and decay)",
           "n ANI >= 95%", "n ANI >= 95% with decay", "Kruskal-Wallis species vs decay: H", "KW df", "KW p",
           "Wilcoxon genus (Pectobacterium vs Dickeya): W", "Wilcoxon genus p", "Spearman rho (ANI vs decay)", "Spearman p",
           "Wilcoxon ANI>=95 vs <95: W", "Wilcoxon ANI tier p", "median decay ANI>=95 (g)", "median decay ANI<95 (g)",
           "n P. versatile ANI>=95 with decay", "median decay P. versatile ANI>=95 (g)", "range decay P. versatile ANI>=95"),
  value = c(nrow(iso), sum(!is.na(iso$id_ani)), sum(iso$wgs_status == "Outlier"), sum(!is.na(iso$decay_g)), nrow(an),
            sum(iso$ani >= 95, na.rm = TRUE), nrow(hi), unname(kw$statistic), unname(kw$parameter), kw$p.value,
            unname(wg$statistic), wg$p.value, unname(rho$estimate), rho$p.value,
            unname(wt$statistic), wt$p.value, median(hi$decay_g), median(lo$decay_g),
            nrow(pv_ver), median(pv_ver$decay_g), NA) %>% as.character())
iso_stats$value[iso_stats$stat == "range decay P. versatile ANI>=95"] <- sprintf("%.2f-%.2f", min(pv_ver$decay_g), max(pv_ver$decay_g))
write_tab(iso_stats, "T_isolate_statistics")
print(iso_stats, n = 30)
p8B <- ggplot(an, aes(ani, decay_g)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 95, linewidth = .4, colour = ink3, linetype = "22") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = genus, shape = tier), size = 2.8, colour = ink, stroke = .5) +
  annotate("text", x = 94, y = 22.2, label = "95% species-level\nthreshold", hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 2.6 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam, lineheight = .9) +
  annotate("text", x = 77.8, y = 24.6, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.9 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam,
           label = sprintf("Spearman rho = %.2f, p %s", rho$estimate, ifelse(rho$p.value < .001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", rho$p.value)))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gen_pal, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = setNames(c(21, 24), c(tier_hi, tier_lo)), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(77.5, 100.5), breaks = seq(80, 100, 5)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 25)) +
  labs(x = "Reported ANI (%)", y = "Decayed tissue weight (g)") + theme_ms(10)
fig8 <- (p8A / p8B) + plot_layout(heights = c(1.1, 1)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") & theme(plot.tag.position = c(0, 1))
save_ms(fig8, "Fig8_isolates_ANI_decay", 7.2, 8.2)

show_fig("Fig8_isolates_ANI_decay")
```
