## Figure 9. Genome-distance tree of all sequenced isolates and the reference genomes

Mashtree tree (neighbour joining on Mash distances) of every sequenced isolate, the reference genomes of the genera and the *Erwinia amylovora* outgroup (root). Node labels are bootstrap support (0-100; below 70 in orange); each replicate re-runs Mashtree with a different Mash seed, so support reflects k-mer sampling, not alignment resampling. The scale bar is Mash distance (about 1 - ANI). Circles: isolates with reported ANI of 95% or more; triangles: below 95%; diamonds: references. Beside the tree: species group (bracket; named after the reference genome in the group; Unassigned = reported ANI below 95% to every reference, so the best hit is not a species assignment), closest reference species by ANI (best hit only when below 95%), reported ANI, source and pitting on CVP agar. A dagger marks an assembly with about twice the usual number of fastANI query fragments (more than 1.6 times the median), possibly more than one genome; its bracket follows its nearest neighbour in the tree (`fastani_allvsall.tsv`, optional). Input: `mashtree_ALL_bootstrap.nwk` (ASA3P notebook v5.4.2, step D3); the figure is skipped when absent.

```{r fig9-tree-read}
data_path_tree <- file.path(data_dir, "mashtree_ALL_bootstrap.nwk")
have_tree <- file.exists(data_path_tree)
if (!have_tree) {
  cat("mashtree_ALL_bootstrap.nwk was not found in", data_dir, "- Figure 9 is skipped.",
      "Copy downstream/trees/mashtree_ALL_bootstrap.nwk from the HPC into that folder and knit again.\n")
}
```

```{r asm-flag}
# Assemblies with about twice the usual number of fastANI query fragments (probably more than one genome in the assembly).
data_path_fani <- file.path(data_dir, "fastani_allvsall.tsv")
asm_flag <- tibble(label = character(), n_fragments = numeric(), median_fragments = numeric(), flag = logical())
if (file.exists(data_path_fani)) {
  asm_flag <- readr::read_tsv(data_path_fani, col_names = c("query", "ref", "ani", "matched", "total"), col_types = "ccddd", progress = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(label = sub("\\.fn?a$", "", basename(query)), n_fragments = total) %>%
    group_by(label) %>% summarise(n_fragments = max(n_fragments), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(median_fragments = median(n_fragments), flag = n_fragments > 1.6 * median_fragments)
}
dagger <- intToUtf8(0x2020)
```

```{r fig9-tree-prepare, eval = have_tree}
# ---- read, root on the outgroup, order the tips -------------------------------------------------
tr0 <- ape::read.tree(data_path_tree)
og_tip <- grep("^OUT_", tr0$tip.label, value = TRUE)
stopifnot("the tree must have exactly one tip that starts with OUT_ (the outgroup)" = length(og_tip) == 1)
if (ape::is.rooted(tr0)) tr0 <- ape::unroot(tr0)
# edgelabel = TRUE: the node labels are supports of splits, so they travel with the split when the root moves
tr <- ape::root(tr0, outgroup = og_tip, resolve.root = TRUE, edgelabel = TRUE)
# Check: every support value must still sit on the same split (the same set of tips) as in the file.
split_labels <- function(t, ref) {
  pp <- ape::prop.part(t); lab_all <- attr(pp, "labels"); out <- character()
  for (i in seq_along(pp)[-1]) {
    s_i <- lab_all[pp[[i]]]; if (ref %in% s_i) s_i <- setdiff(t$tip.label, s_i)
    if (length(s_i) >= 2 && length(t$tip.label) - length(s_i) >= 2) out[paste(sort(s_i), collapse = "|")] <- t$node.label[i]
  }
  out
}
sl0 <- split_labels(tr0, og_tip); sl1 <- split_labels(tr, og_tip)
stopifnot("rooting moved a support value to a different split" = all(names(sl0) %in% names(sl1)) && all(sl0 == sl1[names(sl0)]))
cat("Rooting check passed: all", length(sl0), "support values are on the same splits as in the file.\n")
tr <- ape::ladderize(tr, right = TRUE)                       # larger clades first, the outgroup ends at the bottom
n_tip <- length(tr$tip.label); root_id <- n_tip + 1L
support <- rep(NA_real_, n_tip + tr$Nnode)
support[(n_tip + 1L):(n_tip + tr$Nnode)] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tr$node.label))
if (all(is.na(support))) warning("The tree has no node labels: it was not made by mashtree_bootstrap.pl, so no support is shown.")

# ---- layout: x = distance from the root, y = row (top row has the largest y) -----------------
ed   <- tr$edge
kids <- split(ed[, 2], ed[, 1])
xd   <- ape::node.depth.edgelength(tr)
yy   <- rep(NA_real_, n_tip + tr$Nnode)
yy[ed[ed[, 2] <= n_tip, 2]] <- rev(seq_len(n_tip))         # tips in the order of the (clade-wise) edge matrix
fill_y <- function(nd) {
  if (nd <= n_tip) return(yy[nd])
  ys <- vapply(kids[[as.character(nd)]], fill_y, numeric(1))
  yy[nd] <<- (min(ys) + max(ys)) / 2
  yy[nd]
}
invisible(fill_y(root_id))

# The outgroup branch is much longer than the rest of the tree: draw it shortened (with a break) when it is
og_id    <- match(og_tip, tr$tip.label)
ing_max  <- max(xd[setdiff(seq_len(n_tip), og_id)])
og_len   <- xd[og_id]
og_cap   <- 1.12 * ing_max
og_break <- og_len > og_cap
xd_plot  <- xd; xd_plot[og_id] <- ifelse(og_break, og_cap, og_len)

hseg <- tibble(parent = ed[, 1], child = ed[, 2]) %>%
  mutate(x0 = xd_plot[parent], x1 = xd_plot[child], y = yy[child])
vseg <- tibble(node = unique(ed[, 1])) %>%
  mutate(x = xd_plot[node], ymin = vapply(node, function(k) min(yy[kids[[as.character(k)]]]), numeric(1)),
         ymax = vapply(node, function(k) max(yy[kids[[as.character(k)]]]), numeric(1)))

# tips: kind, isolate code, annotation
fmt_ref <- function(lbl) vapply(lbl, function(l) {
  s <- sub("^(REF|OUT)_", "", l); s <- sub("^Erwinia_", "E", s)       # Erwinia_amylovora_X -> Eamylovora_X
  p <- strsplit(s, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  paste0("*", substr(p[1], 1, 1), ". ", substring(p[1], 2), "*", if (length(p) > 1) paste0(" ", paste(p[-1], collapse = " ")) else "")
}, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
abbr_sp <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, sub("^([A-Za-z])[a-z]+ (.+)$", "*\\1. \\2*", x))

tip_key <- feat_join %>% transmute(label = isolate_short, isolate_code)
tips <- tibble(label = tr$tip.label, x_end = xd_plot[seq_len(n_tip)], y = yy[seq_len(n_tip)]) %>%
  mutate(kind = case_when(startsWith(label, "OUT_") ~ "outgroup", startsWith(label, "REF_") ~ "reference", TRUE ~ "isolate")) %>%
  left_join(tip_key, by = "label") %>%
  left_join(D$geno %>% transmute(isolate_code, ani, tier, id_ani, source = environment_type, pit_chr),
            by = "isolate_code") %>%
  left_join(asm_flag %>% select(label, mixed = flag), by = "label") %>%
  mutate(mixed = !is.na(mixed) & mixed)
unmatched <- tips %>% filter(kind == "isolate", is.na(ani)) %>% pull(label)
if (length(unmatched) > 0) warning("Tips without a matching sequenced isolate (no annotation drawn): ", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))
tips <- tips %>% mutate(
  disp = case_when(kind == "isolate" & !is.na(isolate_code) ~ paste0("**", isolate_code, "**", ifelse(mixed, dagger, "")),
                   kind == "isolate" ~ label,
                   kind == "outgroup" ~ paste0(fmt_ref(label), " (outgroup)"),
                   TRUE ~ fmt_ref(label)),
  sp_ani = abbr_sp(id_ani),
  source = str_to_sentence(source))
cat(sprintf("Tree: %d tips (%d isolates, %d references, 1 outgroup); %d internal nodes with a support value (minimum %s, median %s).\n",
            n_tip, sum(tips$kind == "isolate"), sum(tips$kind == "reference"), sum(!is.na(support)),
            ifelse(all(is.na(support)), "n.a.", min(support, na.rm = TRUE)), ifelse(all(is.na(support)), "n.a.", median(support, na.rm = TRUE))))

# ---- node table (also the numbers quoted in the text) --------------------------------------------
desc_tips <- function(nd) { if (nd <= n_tip) return(nd); unlist(lapply(kids[[as.character(nd)]], desc_tips)) }
parent_of <- setNames(ed[, 1], ed[, 2])
node_tab <- tibble(node = (n_tip + 1L):(n_tip + tr$Nnode)) %>%
  mutate(support = support[node],
         d     = map(node, desc_tips),
         n_tips = lengths(d),
         n_isolates = map_int(d, ~ sum(tips$kind[.x] == "isolate")),
         n_references = map_int(d, ~ sum(tips$kind[.x] == "reference")),
         members = map_chr(d, ~ paste(ifelse(!is.na(tips$isolate_code[.x]), tips$isolate_code[.x], sub("^(REF|OUT)_", "", tips$label[.x])), collapse = ", ")),
         branch_length = map_dbl(node, ~ ifelse(.x == root_id, NA_real_, tr$edge.length[match(.x, ed[, 2])]))) %>%
  filter(node != root_id, n_tips < n_tip - 1L) %>%               # the root and the split "outgroup | all others" carry no information
  select(-d) %>% arrange(desc(n_tips))
save_table(node_tab, "T_mashtree_node_support")
cat(sprintf("Nodes: %d; support >= 90: %d; 70-89: %d; < 70: %d.\n", nrow(node_tab), sum(node_tab$support >= 90, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(node_tab$support >= 70 & node_tab$support < 90, na.rm = TRUE), sum(node_tab$support < 70, na.rm = TRUE)))

# ---- species groups for the bracket column -------------------------------------------------------
# Reference tips: species of the reference (Dickeya references form one genus group). Isolates: closest species when ANI is 95% or more,
# otherwise Unassigned. A mixed assembly takes the group of its nearest neighbours in the tree, as long as they agree.
ref_group <- function(l) vapply(l, function(x) {
  p <- strsplit(sub("^(REF|OUT)_", "", x), "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]][1]
  if (substr(p, 1, 1) == "D") "Dickeya" else paste0(substr(p, 1, 1), ". ", substring(p, 2))
}, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
tips <- tips %>% mutate(group = case_when(
  kind == "reference" ~ ref_group(label),
  kind == "isolate" & !is.na(tier) & tier == tier_lo ~ "Unassigned",
  kind == "isolate" & !is.na(id_ani) ~ sub("^([A-Za-z])[a-z]+ (.+)$", "\\1. \\2", id_ani),
  TRUE ~ NA_character_))
for (m in which(tips$mixed)) {
  nd <- unname(parent_of[as.character(m)])
  repeat {
    g <- unique(stats::na.omit(tips$group[setdiff(desc_tips(nd), which(tips$mixed))]))
    if (length(g) == 1) { tips$group[m] <- g; break }
    if (length(g) > 1 || nd == root_id) break
    nd <- unname(parent_of[as.character(nd)])
  }
}
br <- tips %>% filter(kind != "outgroup", !is.na(group)) %>% arrange(desc(y)) %>%
  mutate(run = cumsum(group != dplyr::lag(group, default = dplyr::first(group)))) %>%
  group_by(run, group) %>% summarise(ymin = min(y), ymax = max(y), n_tips = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(lab = ifelse(group == "Unassigned", group, paste0("*", group, "*")))
save_table(tips %>% filter(kind != "outgroup") %>% transmute(tip = label, isolate_code, kind, reported_ani = ani, closest_species_by_ani = id_ani,
                                                              mixed_assembly = mixed, species_group = group) %>% arrange(species_group, tip), "T_mashtree_species_groups")
cat(sprintf("Species groups (brackets): %s\n", paste(sprintf("%s (%d)", br$group, br$n_tips), collapse = "; ")))
```

```{r fig9, fig.keep='none', eval = have_tree}
n <- n_tip
# Text sizes of Figure 9 in points on the 12.7-inch canvas (ggplot sizes are in mm: 1 pt = 1/.pt mm). The smallest text (bootstrap
# values, key, scale bar) is kept at 10 pt or more; names and headers are 12.5 pt.
s9 <- function(pt) pt * (font_scale / 1.3) / ggplot2::.pt
pt_main <- 12.5; pt_cell <- 11.5; pt_small <- 10.5
tip_size <- 2.1                                                   # tree symbols and key symbols (mm)
y_lo <- -2.4; y_hi <- n + 0.5          # room under the tree for the scale bar; the key has its own strip below
sup_df <- tibble(node = (n_tip + 1L):(n_tip + tr$Nnode)) %>%
  mutate(support = support[node], x = xd_plot[node], y = yy[node], parent = parent_of[as.character(node)]) %>%
  left_join(node_tab %>% select(node) %>% mutate(keep = TRUE), by = "node") %>%
  filter(!is.na(keep), !is.na(support))
x_right <- max(tips$x_end)
sb <- if (ing_max > 0.12) 0.05 else if (ing_max > 0.05) 0.02 else 0.01      # scale bar in Mash distance
# Geometry of the figure (inches, points), used to keep the support values from overlapping each other
top_pt <- 100; right_pt <- 90                                       # top margin (rotated headers) and right margin (last header)
w9 <- c(3.6, 2.25, 1.9, 1.5, .75, .75, .7)                          # panel widths: tree, names, brackets, closest species, ANI, source, pitting
fig_h9 <- max(6.4, 0.225 * (n + 4) + 2.4)
tree_in <- w9[1] * (12.7 - (14 + 3 + 5 * 6 + 3 + right_pt) / 72) / sum(w9)   # width of the tree panel, inches
ux <- (x_right * 1.04 + .005) / tree_in                             # x data units per inch in the tree panel
uy <- (y_hi - y_lo) / (fig_h9 - (top_pt + 4) / 72)                  # y data units per inch
sz_sup <- pt_small - .5
sup_df <- sup_df %>% arrange(desc(y), x) %>%
  mutate(w_in = nchar(sprintf("%.0f", support)) * .556 * sz_sup / 72 + .05, h_in = sz_sup / 72 * 1.1, ylab = NA_real_)
placed <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(sup_df))) {                                  # greedy: try the node's own level, then nudge down / up
  xr <- sup_df$x[i] - .3 * sup_df$w_in[i] * ux; xl <- xr - sup_df$w_in[i] * ux
  for (dy in c(0, -.5, .5, -1, 1) * sup_df$h_in[i] * uy) {
    yb <- sup_df$y[i] + .1 + dy; yt <- yb + sup_df$h_in[i] * uy
    hit <- any(vapply(placed, function(b) xl < b[2] && xr > b[1] && yb < b[4] && yt > b[3], logical(1)))
    if (!hit) break
  }
  placed[[i]] <- c(xl, xr, yb, yt); sup_df$ylab[i] <- yb
}
tip_pts <- tips %>% filter(kind != "outgroup") %>%
  mutate(shp = case_when(kind == "reference" ~ "ref", tier == tier_lo ~ "lo", TRUE ~ "hi"))
base_theme <- theme_void(base_family = fam) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA), plot.margin = margin(top_pt, 3, 4, 3))   # no panel background: the rotated headers run over the next panel
ycoord <- function(xlim) coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, ylim = c(y_lo, y_hi), expand = FALSE, clip = "off")   # y by the coordinate system: headers above the top row are kept

# A. tree
p_tree <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = tips, aes(x = x_end, xend = x_right, y = y, yend = y), colour = "#cfcec8", linewidth = .25, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_segment(data = hseg, aes(x = x0, xend = x1, y = y, yend = y), linewidth = .45, colour = ink2) +
  geom_segment(data = vseg, aes(x = x, xend = x, y = ymin, yend = ymax), linewidth = .45, colour = ink2) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(data = sup_df, aes(x = x, y = ylab, label = sprintf("%.0f", support), colour = support < 70),
                        hjust = 1.3, vjust = 0, fill = alpha("white", .8), label.colour = NA, label.padding = unit(.7, "pt"),
                        size = s9(pt_small - .5), family = fam) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#c2451c", `FALSE` = ink_t), guide = "none") +
  geom_point(data = tip_pts, aes(x = x_end, y = y, shape = shp, fill = shp), size = tip_size, colour = ink, stroke = .45) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(hi = 21, lo = 24, ref = 23), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(hi = ink2, lo = "white", ref = "#cfcec8"), guide = "none") +
  annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = sb, y = -0.2, yend = -0.2, linewidth = .6, colour = ink) +
  annotate("segment", x = c(0, sb), xend = c(0, sb), y = -0.45, yend = 0.05, linewidth = .6, colour = ink) +
  annotate("text", x = sb / 2, y = -0.75, label = sprintf("%.2f", sb), size = s9(pt_cell), colour = ink_t, family = fam, vjust = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = -1.45, label = "Mash distance", size = s9(pt_cell), colour = ink_t, family = fam, vjust = 1, hjust = 0) +
  ycoord(c(-0.005, x_right * 1.04)) + base_theme +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(top_pt, 3, 4, 14))      # room on the left for the support values at the root
if (og_break) {   # break mark on the shortened outgroup branch, true length in the label
  y_og <- tips$y[tips$kind == "outgroup"]; xb <- og_cap * .86
  p_tree <- p_tree + annotate("segment", x = xb + c(-1, 1) * ing_max * .012 - ing_max * .006, xend = xb + c(-1, 1) * ing_max * .012 + ing_max * .006,
                              y = y_og - .35, yend = y_og + .35, linewidth = .45, colour = ink2)
}

# B. labels
lab_df <- tips %>% mutate(txt_col = ink_t)
p_lab <- ggplot(lab_df, aes(0, y)) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(aes(label = disp, colour = txt_col), hjust = 0, fill = NA, label.colour = NA, label.padding = unit(0, "pt"),
                        size = s9(pt_main), family = fam) +
  scale_colour_identity() + ycoord(c(0, 1)) + base_theme

# column helper: header text above the top row
hdr <- function(x, lab, hjust = 0) annotate("text", x = x, y = n + 0.9, label = lab, angle = 35, hjust = hjust, vjust = 0, size = s9(pt_main), family = fam, colour = ink_t, fontface = "bold")
iso_only <- tips %>% filter(kind == "isolate", !is.na(ani))

# B2. species group brackets
p_br <- ggplot(br) +

  geom_segment(aes(x = .06, xend = .16, y = ymin - .32, yend = ymin - .32), linewidth = .5, colour = ink) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = .06, xend = .16, y = ymax + .32, yend = ymax + .32), linewidth = .5, colour = ink) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(aes(x = .2, y = (ymin + ymax) / 2, label = lab), hjust = 0, fill = NA, label.colour = NA,
                        label.padding = unit(0, "pt"), size = s9(pt_main), family = fam, colour = ink_t) +
  hdr(.06, "Species group") + ycoord(c(0, 1)) + base_theme

# C. closest species by ANI
p_sp <- ggplot(iso_only, aes(0, y)) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(aes(label = sp_ani, colour = ink_t), hjust = 0, fill = NA, label.colour = NA,
                        label.padding = unit(0, "pt"), size = s9(pt_main), family = fam) +
  scale_colour_identity() + hdr(0, "Closest species by ANI") +
  ycoord(c(0, 1)) + base_theme

# D. reported ANI
p_ani <- ggplot(iso_only, aes(1, y, fill = tier)) +
  geom_tile(width = 1, height = .86, colour = NA) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(ani > 99.9, ">99.9", sprintf("%.1f", ani))), size = s9(pt_cell), colour = ink_t, family = fam) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#cfcec8", "#f3f2ee"), c(tier_hi, tier_lo)), guide = "none") +
  hdr(1, "Reported ANI (%)") + ycoord(c(.5, 1.5)) + base_theme

# E. source
src_fill <- c(Plant = "#cfe7da", Water = "#cfe0f5", Air = "#f5e3c4")
p_src <- ggplot(iso_only, aes(1, y, fill = source)) +
  geom_tile(width = 1, height = .86, colour = NA) +
  geom_text(aes(label = source), size = s9(pt_cell), colour = ink_t, family = fam) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = src_fill, guide = "none") +
  hdr(1, "Source") + ycoord(c(.5, 1.5)) + base_theme

# F. pitting on CVP agar
pit9 <- iso_only %>% transmute(y, pf = as.character(pit_factor(pit_chr))) %>%
  mutate(fill_col = unname(pit_cols[pf]), lab = ifelse(pf == "not tested", "n.t.", unname(pit_lab[pf])), dark = pf %in% c("++", "+++"),
         txt_col = ifelse(dark, "white", ink_t))
p_pit <- ggplot(pit9, aes(1, y, fill = fill_col)) +
  geom_tile(width = 1, height = .86, colour = NA) +
  geom_text(aes(label = lab, colour = txt_col), size = s9(pt_cell), family = fam) +
  scale_colour_identity() + scale_fill_identity() +
  hdr(1, "Pitting on CVP agar") + ycoord(c(.5, 1.5)) + base_theme +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(top_pt, right_pt, 4, 3))                       # room for the rotated header of the last column

# G. key: one strip under the whole figure; positions in inches from the text widths, so nothing collides
key <- tibble(
  shape = c(21, 24, 23, NA, NA),
  fill  = c(ink2, "white", "#cfcec8", NA, NA),
  col   = c(ink_t, ink_t, ink_t, "#c2451c", ink_t),
  lab   = c(paste0("ANI ", intToUtf8(0x2265), " 95%"), "ANI < 95%", "Reference genome", "Support < 70",
            if (any(tips$mixed)) paste0(dagger, " Mixed assembly (about twice the usual size)") else NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lab))
txt_in <- vapply(key$lab, function(s) systemfonts::shape_string(s, family = fam, size = pt_small + 1)$metrics$width, numeric(1)) / 72 * (font_scale / 1.3)
sym_w <- ifelse(is.na(key$shape), 0, .24)                          # room for the symbol before the text
gap <- .42
key$x_sym <- .12 + c(0, cumsum(sym_w + txt_in + gap))[seq_len(nrow(key))]
key$x_txt <- key$x_sym + sym_w
key_h <- .5
p_key <- ggplot(key) +
  geom_point(data = filter(key, !is.na(shape)), aes(x = x_sym + .06, y = .5, shape = shape, fill = fill), size = tip_size, colour = ink, stroke = .45) +
  scale_shape_identity() + scale_fill_identity() +
  geom_text(aes(x = x_txt, y = .5, label = lab, colour = col), hjust = 0, size = s9(pt_small + 1), family = fam) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 12.7), ylim = c(0, 1), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") + theme_void(base_family = fam) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

fig9 <- ((p_tree | p_lab | p_br | p_sp | p_ani | p_src | p_pit) + plot_layout(widths = w9)) / p_key +
  plot_layout(heights = c(fig_h9, key_h))
save_ms(fig9, "Fig9_mashtree_all_isolates", 12.7, fig_h9 + key_h)

show_fig("Fig9_mashtree_all_isolates")
```

### T5aSS in the sequenced isolates (Figure 10C)

T5aSS (yes/no) in the 25 sequenced isolates by ANI tier and genus, and against decayed tissue weight (isolates with a measurement; decaying = mean of 1 g or more, checked for means near the cut-off). The exact test is descriptive: T5aSS, ANI tier and genus coincide in these isolates.

```{r t5ass-summary}
t5_tier <- geno %>% group_by(tier) %>% summarise(n_isolates = n(), n_T5aSS = sum(t5ass == 1), n_no_T5aSS = sum(t5ass == 0), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(tier = as.character(tier))
t5_genus <- geno %>% group_by(genus) %>% summarise(n_isolates = n(), n_T5aSS = sum(t5ass == 1), n_no_T5aSS = sum(t5ass == 0), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(genus = as.character(genus))
save_table(t5_tier, "T_t5ass_by_ani_tier"); save_table(t5_genus, "T_t5ass_by_genus")
print(t5_tier); print(t5_genus)
cat("T5aSS absent in:", paste(geno$isolate_code[geno$t5ass == 0], collapse = ", "), "\n")

cut_t5 <- 1   # g
t5 <- geno %>% filter(!is.na(decay_g)) %>%
  mutate(decay_class = factor(ifelse(decay_g >= cut_t5, "decaying", "not decaying"), c("decaying", "not decaying")),
         T5aSS = factor(ifelse(t5ass == 1, "present", "absent"), c("present", "absent")))
cat(sprintf("Decayed tissue weight: not decaying <= %.2f g, decaying >= %.2f g (cut-off %.1f g); %d isolates with a measurement.\n",
            max(t5$decay_g[t5$decay_class == "not decaying"]), min(t5$decay_g[t5$decay_class == "decaying"]), cut_t5, nrow(t5)))
tx <- table(t5$decay_class, t5$T5aSS)
ftx <- fisher.test(tx)
t5_tab <- tibble(decay_class = rownames(tx), n_isolates = as.integer(rowSums(tx)), T5aSS_present = as.integer(tx[, "present"]), T5aSS_absent = as.integer(tx[, "absent"]),
                 odds_ratio_T5aSS_in_decaying = unname(ftx$estimate), fisher_p = ftx$p.value)
save_table(t5_tab, "T_t5ass_vs_decay"); print(t5_tab)
t5_exc <- t5 %>% filter((decay_class == "decaying" & t5ass == 0) | (decay_class == "not decaying" & t5ass == 1)) %>%
  transmute(isolate_code, genus = as.character(genus), ani_tier = as.character(tier), decay_class = as.character(decay_class), decay_g = round(decay_g, 2), T5aSS = as.character(T5aSS)) %>%
  arrange(decay_class, genus, isolate_code)
save_table(t5_exc, "T_t5ass_vs_decay_exceptions"); print(t5_exc)
```
## Figure 10. Cell-wall-degrading enzyme genes, T5aSS and pitting against decayed tissue weight

(A, B) Genes in pectin- and hemicellulose-degrading enzyme classes and (C) T5aSS (type V secretion system subtype a) against decayed tissue weight, one point per isolate; fill = pitting on CVP agar (grey, not tested), shape = ANI tier. (D) Decayed tissue weight by pitting score (bar = median). Counts and scores are jittered horizontally (fixed seed). Text above each panel: Spearman correlation for all isolates with a measurement and within each ANI tier (`T_genomic_features_spearman.csv`, `T_t5ass_spearman_vs_decay.csv`, `T_pitting_vs_decay.csv`); `n.a.` = a variable does not vary. Isolates without a measurement are not shown.

```{r fig10, fig.keep='none'}
g10 <- D$geno %>% filter(!is.na(decay_g)) %>% mutate(pit_f = pit_factor(pit_chr))
rho_chr <- intToUtf8(0x03c1)
p_txt <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p))
tier_short <- setNames(c("All", paste0("ANI ", intToUtf8(0x2265), " 95%"), "ANI < 95%"), c("All isolates", tier_hi, tier_lo))
ann_text <- function(tab) paste(sprintf("%s (n = %d): %s", tier_short[tab$subset], tab$n,
                                        ifelse(is.na(tab$rho), "n.a.", sprintf("%s = %.2f, %s", rho_chr, tab$rho, p_txt(tab$p)))), collapse = "\n")
ann_for <- function(f) ann_text(D$cor_tab %>% filter(outcome == "decay_g", feature == f) %>% arrange(match(subset, names(tier_short))))
# T5aSS (0/1) against decayed tissue weight, Spearman (rank correlation with the 0/1 coding), same subsets and test as the enzyme genes
cor_t5 <- map_dfr(names(subset_def), function(sb) {
  d <- geno[which(subset_def[[sb]]), ]
  safe_spearman(d$t5ass, d$decay_g) %>% mutate(subset = sb, .before = 1)
})
write_tab(cor_t5, "T_t5ass_spearman_vs_decay")
ann_t5 <- ann_text(cor_t5)
fill_sc  <- scale_fill_manual(values = pit_cols, labels = pit_lab, name = "Pitting on CVP agar", drop = FALSE)
shape_sc <- scale_shape_manual(values = setNames(c(21, 24), c(tier_hi, tier_lo)), name = "Reported ANI", drop = FALSE)
leg_guides <- guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 3), order = 1), shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey70"), order = 2))
panel10 <- function(f, xlab, binary = FALSE, ann = ann_for(f)) {
  d <- g10
  if (binary) d <- d %>% mutate(x = factor(ifelse(.data[[f]] == 1, "Present", "Absent"), c("Absent", "Present"))) else d <- d %>% mutate(x = .data[[f]])
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x, decay_g)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = pit_f, shape = tier), position = position_jitter(width = if (binary) .14 else .12, height = 0, seed = 11),
               size = 2.7, colour = ink, stroke = .5) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = ann, hjust = -0.02, vjust = -0.35, size = 2.35 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam, lineheight = .95) +
    fill_sc + shape_sc + leg_guides +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 25), breaks = seq(0, 25, 5)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Decayed tissue weight (g)") + theme_ms(10) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(54, 8, 6, 6))
  if (!binary) p <- p + scale_x_continuous(breaks = function(l) seq(ceiling(l[1]), floor(l[2]), by = 1), expand = expansion(add = .6))
  p
}
# E. decayed tissue weight by pitting score (sequenced isolates)
pe <- g10 %>% filter(!is.na(pitting)) %>% mutate(x = factor(pit_chr, pit_levels))
n_lv <- as.integer(table(pe$x)[pit_levels])
ann_E <- ann_text(D$pit_decay_tab %>% filter(set == "Sequenced isolates (PCWDE data)") %>% arrange(match(subset, names(tier_short))))
pE <- ggplot(pe, aes(x, decay_g)) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, fun.min = median, fun.max = median, geom = "errorbar", width = .55, linewidth = .55, colour = ink2) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = pit_f, shape = tier), position = position_jitter(width = .14, height = 0, seed = 11), size = 2.7, colour = ink, stroke = .5) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = ann_E, hjust = -0.02, vjust = -0.35, size = 2.35 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam, lineheight = .95) +
  fill_sc + shape_sc + leg_guides +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = pit_levels, labels = sprintf("%s<br>(n = %d)", unname(pit_lab[pit_levels]), n_lv)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 25), breaks = seq(0, 25, 5)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Pitting on CVP agar", y = "Decayed tissue weight (g)") + theme_ms(10) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(54, 8, 6, 6))
fig10 <- (panel10("pectin", "Pectin-like PCWDE genes (n)") + panel10("hemicellulose", "Hemicellulose-like PCWDE genes (n)") +
          panel10("t5ass", "T5aSS", binary = TRUE, ann = ann_t5) + pE) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(legend.box = "vertical", legend.justification = "left", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), plot.tag.position = c(0, 1),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9 * font_scale))
save_ms(fig10, "Fig10_pcwde_t5ass_pitting_vs_decay", 8.9, 8.0)

show_fig("Fig10_pcwde_t5ass_pitting_vs_decay")
```

## Figure 11. Correlation of the genomic features with decayed tissue weight, ANI and pitting

Spearman coefficients between each genomic feature (rows) and decayed tissue weight, reported ANI or pitting score (column groups), for all isolates and within each ANI tier (n = isolates per column). Grey = not applicable (a variable does not vary). Asterisk = BH-adjusted p below 0.05 across the four features in that column. Values: `T_genomic_features_spearman.csv`.

```{r fig11, fig.keep='none'}
ht <- D$cor_tab %>%
  group_by(outcome, subset) %>% mutate(n_col = max(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(col_lab     = sprintf("%s<br>(n = %d)", tier_short[subset], n_col),
         outcome_lab = factor(outcome_lab, c("Decayed tissue weight", "Reported ANI", "Pitting score on CVP agar")),
         row_lab     = factor(feature_lab, rev(feat_lab)),
         lab         = ifelse(is.na(rho), "n.a.", sprintf("%.2f%s", rho, ifelse(!is.na(q_bh) & q_bh < .05, "*", ""))),
         txt_col     = ifelse(!is.na(rho) & abs(rho) > .6, "white", ink_t)) %>%
  arrange(outcome_lab, match(subset, names(tier_short)))
# one key per column group and subset (the same label can occur in two groups)
ht$col_key <- factor(paste(ht$outcome, ht$subset, sep = "|"), levels = unique(paste(ht$outcome, ht$subset, sep = "|")))
col_labs <- setNames(ht$col_lab, as.character(ht$col_key))
p11 <- ggplot(ht, aes(col_key, row_lab, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = lab, colour = txt_col), size = 3.1 * font_scale, family = fam) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2a78d6", mid = "#f3f2ee", high = "#eb6834", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), na.value = "#e6e5df",
                       name = paste0("Spearman ", rho_chr), breaks = c(-1, -.5, 0, .5, 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = col_labs) +
  facet_grid(. ~ outcome_lab, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_ms(10) +
  theme(axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.spacing = unit(1.4, "lines"),
        legend.position = "right", legend.key.height = unit(1.6, "lines"), axis.text.x = element_markdown(lineheight = .95, colour = ink_t))
save_ms(p11, "Fig11_feature_correlations", 13.4, 3.9)

show_fig("Fig11_feature_correlations")
```
## Figure 12. All genome features of the sequenced isolates

One row per sequenced isolate, grouped by lineage (L1 to L3 and singletons from the Pectobacterium tree; the last group holds isolates not in that tree, all below 95% ANI) and ordered within groups by feature similarity (average-linkage clustering of standardised features, fixed order). Columns: reported ANI and source; secretion systems, Tad pilus and flagellum (dark = detected); gene counts for CAZymes and the three PCWDE classes; effector candidate flag; plasmid-like, virus and provirus elements. Count shading is scaled within each column (log scale for mobile elements). Values come from `pathogenicity_secretome_matrix_25.xlsx`, except the mobile element counts (metadata workbook); all are in `T_genome_features_all_isolates.csv`. Descriptive only (lineage and ANI tier coincide).

```{r fig12, fig.keep='none'}
sec_cols  <- c("T1SS", "T2SS", "T3SS", "T5aSS", "T5bSS", "T5cSS", "T6SSi", "T6SSii", "T6SSiii", "pT4SSi", "pT4SSt", "Tad", "Flagellum")
caz_cols  <- c("total_cazymes", "pcwde_pectin_like", "pcwde_hemicellulose_like", "pcwde_cellulose_like")
mob_cols  <- c("plasmid_like_count", "virus_count", "provirus_count")
need_mat  <- c("sample_raw", "lineage", sec_cols, caz_cols, "known_effector_like_keywords", "effector_candidate")
stopifnot("secretome matrix is missing a column needed for Figure 12" = all(need_mat %in% names(feat_raw)),
          "metadata workbook is missing a mobile-element column"      = all(c("full_sample_name", mob_cols) %in% names(meta_raw)),
          "a secretion system column is not 0/1"                      = all(unlist(feat_raw[sec_cols]) %in% c(0, 1)))

# One row per isolate: everything in the matrix + the mobile element counts + ANI / provisional genus (no sample barcode, no grower or site)
geno_all <- feat_join %>%
  left_join(meta_raw %>% select(full_sample_name, all_of(mob_cols)), by = c("sample_raw" = "full_sample_name")) %>%
  left_join(geno %>% select(isolate_code, ani, tier, id_ani, genus), by = "isolate_code") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c(sec_cols, mob_cols, caz_cols)), as.numeric),
         effector = as.integer(effector_candidate == "yes"),
         grp = factor(case_when(lineage %in% c("L1", "L2", "L3", "Singleton") ~ lineage, TRUE ~ "Not in Pectobacterium tree"),
                      c("L1", "L2", "L3", "Singleton", "Not in Pectobacterium tree")))
stopifnot("a mobile element count is missing" = !anyNA(geno_all[mob_cols]), "no ANI for a sequenced isolate" = !anyNA(geno_all$ani))

# ---- table: every feature of every isolate -------------------------------------------------------------
tab12 <- geno_all %>% arrange(grp, isolate_code) %>%
  transmute(isolate_code, lineage, ani_tier = as.character(tier), reported_ani = ani, closest_species_by_ani = id_ani, provisional_genus = as.character(genus),
            source_class, environment_type, across(all_of(sec_cols)), across(all_of(caz_cols)),
            effector_candidate, effector_keyword = coalesce(known_effector_like_keywords, ""), across(all_of(mob_cols)))
save_table(tab12, "T_genome_features_all_isolates")

# prevalence of each yes/no feature, overall and by lineage group
bin_cols <- c(sec_cols, "effector")
prev12 <- map_dfr(bin_cols, function(f) {
  v <- geno_all[[f]]
  tibble(feature = f, n_isolates = sum(v == 1), of = length(v),
         in_ani_hi = sum(v == 1 & geno_all$tier == tier_hi), of_ani_hi = sum(geno_all$tier == tier_hi),
         in_ani_lo = sum(v == 1 & geno_all$tier == tier_lo), of_ani_lo = sum(geno_all$tier == tier_lo),
         !!!setNames(map(levels(geno_all$grp), ~ sum(v[geno_all$grp == .x] == 1)), paste0("n_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", levels(geno_all$grp)))))
})
save_table(prev12, "T_genome_features_prevalence")
cnt12 <- geno_all %>% group_by(grp) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), across(all_of(c(caz_cols, mob_cols)), list(min = min, median = median, max = max), .names = "{.col}__{.fn}"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(grp, n), names_to = c("feature", ".value"), names_sep = "__") %>% mutate(grp = as.character(grp))
save_table(cnt12, "T_genome_features_counts_by_group")
prof <- geno_all %>% unite("profile", all_of(sec_cols), sep = "") %>% count(profile, name = "n_isolates")
cat(sprintf("Secretion system / pilus / flagellum profiles: %d distinct among %d isolates; present in all: %s; in none: %s.\n",
            nrow(prof), nrow(geno_all), paste(bin_cols[colSums(geno_all[bin_cols]) == nrow(geno_all)], collapse = ", "),
            paste(bin_cols[colSums(geno_all[bin_cols]) == 0], collapse = ", ")))
print(prev12, width = Inf); print(cnt12, n = Inf, width = Inf)

abbr_sp12 <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, sub("^([A-Za-z])[a-z]+ (.+)$", "*\\1. \\2*", x))

# ---- figure ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# rows: grouped by lineage; inside a group, isolates with similar features are neighbours (hierarchical clustering, fixed order)
feat_m <- geno_all %>% select(all_of(c(sec_cols, "effector", caz_cols, mob_cols))) %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(scale(.))))

# columns: label, block, kind

) %>% mutate(blk_i = as.integer(factor(block, unique(block))), xk = row_number() + (blk_i - 1) * .55)

bin_on <- "#3a5a7a"; bin_off <- "#eeede8"; cnt_lo <- "#eef4fc"; cnt_hi <- "#184f95"

m12 <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(cols12)), function(i) {
  cc <- cols12$col[i]; v <- rows12[[cc]]
  if (cols12$kind[i] == "bin") {
    tibble(y = rows12$y, xk = cols12$xk[i], fill_col = ifelse(v == 1, bin_on, bin_off), lab = "", txt_col = ink_t)
  } else {
    lg <- cc %in% mob_cols                                     # mobile elements: one outlier, so shading on a log scale
    z <- if (lg) log1p(v) else v
    sc <- (z - min(z)) / pmax(max(z) - min(z), 1e-9)
    tibble(y = rows12$y, xk = cols12$xk[i], fill_col = ramp12(sc), lab = as.character(v), txt_col = ifelse(sc > .6, "white", ink_t))
  }
})
```

## Figure 13. Decayed tissue weight of each isolate, by sample type

Mean decayed tissue weight (bar) with SD (error bar, cut at 0; none where the SD is not available) from `isolate_decay.xlsx`, grouped by sample type (plant, irrigation water, air) in three rows on one scale and ordered by weight. Filled bar = called pathogenic (+), open bar = not pathogenic (-); the number above each group is the number of pathogenic isolates among those tested; bold = genome sequenced. Checks: one weight cut-off separates the calls, group totals match the rows, and means agree with `ani_pathogenicity.xlsx` (differences in `T_decay_table_vs_isolate_file.csv`). Plant and irrigation water isolates are compared (the single air isolate is excluded) with a Fisher exact test (share pathogenic) and a Wilcoxon rank-sum test (mean weight; normal approximation because of ties). The workbook is optional.

```{r fig13-read}
data_path_dec <- file.path(data_dir, "isolate_decay.xlsx")
have_decay <- file.exists(data_path_dec)
if (!have_decay) {
  cat("isolate_decay.xlsx was not found in", data_dir, "- Figure 13 is skipped.\n")
}
```

```{r fig13-data, eval = have_decay}
dec_raw <- read_excel(data_path_dec, sheet = "Isolate decay")
need_dec <- c("Sample Type", "Isolate Code", "Pathogenic (+/-)", "Mean Decay (g)", "SD Decay (g)", "Total Pathogenic")
stopifnot("isolate_decay.xlsx (sheet 'Isolate decay') is missing a column" = all(need_dec %in% names(dec_raw)))
dec <- dec_raw %>%
  transmute(isolate_code = trimws(`Isolate Code`),
            sample_type  = factor(recode(tolower(trimws(`Sample Type`)), stem = "Plant", plant = "Plant", water = "Irrigation water", `irrigation water` = "Irrigation water", air = "Air"),
                                c("Plant", "Irrigation water", "Air")),
            call         = gsub(paste0("[", intToUtf8(0x2212), intToUtf8(0x2013), "]"), "-", trimws(`Pathogenic (+/-)`)),
            mean_g       = as.numeric(`Mean Decay (g)`), sd_g = as.numeric(`SD Decay (g)`),
            total_chr    = `Total Pathogenic`) %>%
  mutate(pathogenic = factor(ifelse(call == "+", "Pathogenic (+)", "Not pathogenic (-)"),
                             c("Pathogenic (+)", "Not pathogenic (-)")),
         sequenced  = isolate_code %in% geno$isolate_code)
stopifnot("an isolate code occurs twice"                          = !anyDuplicated(dec$isolate_code),
          "a sample type is not plant, water or air"                 = !anyNA(dec$sample_type),
          "the pathogenic call must be + or -"                      = all(dec$call %in% c("+", "-")),
          "a mean is missing or not a number"                       = !anyNA(dec$mean_g))

# Checks: one weight cut-off must separate the calls, the group totals must match the rows, and the means must agree with ani_pathogenicity.xlsx
cut_lo <- max(dec$mean_g[dec$call == "-"]); cut_hi <- min(dec$mean_g[dec$call == "+"])
cat(sprintf("Pathogenic calls: every isolate called - has a mean of %.2f g or less, every isolate called + has %.2f g or more (%s).\n",
            cut_lo, cut_hi, ifelse(cut_lo < cut_hi, "one cut-off separates them", "THE CALLS OVERLAP")))
tot <- dec %>% mutate(n_path_stated = as.integer(sub(" of .*", "", total_chr)), n_tested_stated = as.integer(sub(".* of ", "", total_chr))) %>%
  group_by(sample_type) %>%
  summarise(n_path = sum(call == "+"), n_tested = n(), stated_path = first(n_path_stated), stated_tested = first(n_tested_stated), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(ok = n_path == stated_path & n_tested == stated_tested)
if (!all(tot$ok)) warning("The 'Total Pathogenic' column does not match the rows for: ", paste(tot$sample_type[!tot$ok], collapse = ", "))
vs_file <- full_join(dec %>% select(isolate_code, sample_type, table_mean_g = mean_g), isolates %>% select(isolate_code, file_decay_g = decay_g), by = "isolate_code") %>%
  filter(!is.na(table_mean_g) | !is.na(file_decay_g)) %>%
  mutate(difference_g = table_mean_g - file_decay_g,
         status = case_when(is.na(file_decay_g) ~ "in the decay table only", is.na(table_mean_g) ~ "in ani_pathogenicity.xlsx only",
                            abs(difference_g) > .0051 ~ "means differ", TRUE ~ "same (rounding)")) %>%
  filter(status != "same (rounding)")
save_table(vs_file, "T_decay_table_vs_isolate_file")
cat(sprintf("Decay table: %d isolates; %d differ from ani_pathogenicity.xlsx beyond rounding or are in one file only (T_decay_table_vs_isolate_file.csv).\n", nrow(dec), nrow(vs_file)))
if (nrow(vs_file) > 0) print(vs_file)

save_table(dec %>% transmute(isolate_code, sample_type = as.character(sample_type), pathogenic_call = call, mean_decay_g = mean_g, sd_decay_g = sd_g,
                             genome_sequenced = sequenced), "T_isolate_decay_table")
dec_sum <- dec %>% group_by(sample_type) %>%
  summarise(n_isolates = n(), n_pathogenic = sum(call == "+"), pct_pathogenic = 100 * n_pathogenic / n_isolates,
            ci_low = if (n() > 0) 100 * binom.test(sum(call == "+"), n())$conf.int[1] else NA_real_,
            ci_high = if (n() > 0) 100 * binom.test(sum(call == "+"), n())$conf.int[2] else NA_real_,
            median_mean_pathogenic_g = med(mean_g[call == "+"]), min_mean_pathogenic_g = suppressWarnings(min(mean_g[call == "+"])),
            max_mean_pathogenic_g = suppressWarnings(max(mean_g[call == "+"])), n_sequenced = sum(sequenced), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(sample_type = as.character(sample_type))
dec_all <- dec %>% summarise(sample_type = "All isolates", n_isolates = n(), n_pathogenic = sum(call == "+"), pct_pathogenic = 100 * n_pathogenic / n_isolates,
                             ci_low = 100 * binom.test(n_pathogenic, n_isolates)$conf.int[1], ci_high = 100 * binom.test(n_pathogenic, n_isolates)$conf.int[2],
                             median_mean_pathogenic_g = med(mean_g[call == "+"]), min_mean_pathogenic_g = min(mean_g[call == "+"]),
                             max_mean_pathogenic_g = max(mean_g[call == "+"]), n_sequenced = sum(sequenced))
dec_sum <- bind_rows(dec_sum, dec_all)
save_table(dec_sum, "T_isolate_decay_by_sample_type")
print(dec_sum, width = Inf)

# Plant vs irrigation water: share of pathogenic isolates (Fisher exact) and mean decayed weight (Wilcoxon rank-sum, normal approximation because of ties)
sw <- dec %>% filter(sample_type %in% c("Plant", "Irrigation water")) %>% mutate(sample_type = droplevels(sample_type))
fs <- fisher.test(table(sw$sample_type, sw$call))
wl <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(mean_g ~ sample_type, data = sw, exact = FALSE))
dec_tests <- tibble(comparison = "Plant vs irrigation water",
                    test = c("Fisher exact, pathogenic vs not pathogenic", "Wilcoxon rank-sum, mean decayed tissue weight (all isolates)"),
                    statistic = c(unname(fs$estimate), unname(wl$statistic)), statistic_name = c("odds ratio", "W"), p = c(fs$p.value, wl$p.value))
save_table(dec_tests, "T_isolate_decay_plant_vs_water")
print(dec_tests)
```

```{r fig13, fig.keep='none', eval = have_decay}
# ---- Figure 13 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
n_max13 <- max(table(dec$sample_type))
dd <- dec %>% arrange(sample_type, desc(mean_g), isolate_code) %>%
  group_by(sample_type) %>% mutate(x = row_number()) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(lo = pmax(mean_g - sd_g, 0), hi = mean_g + sd_g,
         lab = ifelse(sequenced, paste0("**", isolate_code, "**"), isolate_code))
hdr13 <- dd %>% group_by(sample_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), npos = sum(call == "+"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(lab = sprintf("%s (%d of %d pathogenic)", sample_type, npos, n))
y_top13 <- 35
xlim13 <- c(.3, n_max13 + .7)
row13 <- function(st, y_top = 35, brk = seq(0, 30, 10), legend = FALSE, note = FALSE) {
  d <- dd %>% filter(sample_type == st)
  h <- hdr13 %>% filter(sample_type == st)
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x)) +
    geom_col(aes(y = mean_g, fill = pathogenic), width = .74, colour = ink2, linewidth = .3) +
    geom_errorbar(data = d %>% filter(!is.na(sd_g)), aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = .3, linewidth = .35, colour = ink) +
    geom_text(data = d %>% filter(mean_g < .005), aes(y = .9, label = "0"), size = 2.6 * font_scale, family = fam, colour = ink_t) +   # an isolate with no decayed tissue has no visible bar
    annotate("segment", x = xlim13[1] + .1, xend = xlim13[2] - .1, y = y_top - 1.6, yend = y_top - 1.6, linewidth = .45, colour = ink2) +
    annotate("text", x = xlim13[1] + .1, y = y_top - .7, label = h$lab, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 3 * font_scale, family = fam, fontface = "bold", colour = ink_t) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#3a5a7a", "white"), levels(dd$pathogenic)), limits = levels(dd$pathogenic), drop = FALSE, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = d$x, labels = d$lab, limits = xlim13, expand = expansion(0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = brk, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_top + .8), clip = "off") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_ms(10) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 90, vjust = .5, hjust = 1, size = 8 * font_scale, colour = ink_t), legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin = margin(4, 8, 4, 2))
  if (note) p <- p + annotate("text", x = 7.6, y = 30, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.6 * font_scale, family = fam, colour = ink_t, lineheight = 1.05,
                              label = "Bars, mean; error bars, SD (lower end cut at 0)\nBold, genome-sequenced isolate")
  if (legend) p <- p + theme(legend.position = c(.995, .70), legend.justification = c(1, 1), legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
  p
}
ylab13 <- wrap_elements(full = grid::textGrob("Decayed tissue weight (g)", rot = 90, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10 * font_scale, fontfamily = fam, col = ink_t)))
# same weight scale in all rows: the panel heights are proportional to the y range (the air row is short because its weights are small)
f13 <- (ylab13 | ((row13("Plant", legend = TRUE, note = TRUE) / row13("Irrigation water") / row13("Air", y_top = 9, brk = c(0, 5))) +
                  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, (9 + .8) / (y_top13 + .8))))) + plot_layout(widths = c(.035, 1))
save_ms(f13, "Fig13_isolate_decay_by_sample_type", 7.4, 6.9)

show_fig("Fig13_isolate_decay_by_sample_type")
```

# Supplementary figures

## Figure S1. Sample-level sensitivity analysis and plant-level odds ratios

\(A) Sample-level prevalence by season (positive = at least one positive plant) with exact 95% intervals. (B) Odds ratios of the season contrasts for the plants tested (GEE, plants clustered within samples, independence working correlation, robust SE). (C) Plants tested per sample.

```{r figS1, fig.keep='none'}
ps <- D$prev_sample %>% mutate(target = tgt_fac(target), year = factor(year))
```

## Figure S2. 2026 plant-level co-occurrence

\(A) Jaccard index between targets with exact per-stem pairing (2026 only). (B) Detection patterns across the four assays, ordered by frequency.

```{r figS2, fig.keep='none'}
st <- stem_df
m <- as.matrix(st[, keys]); m[is.na(m)] <- 0
short <- c(pectobacterium_spp = "Pec", p_atrosepticum = "Pa", dickeya_spp = "Dic", d_dianthicola = "Dd")
jac <- expand_grid(i = 1:4, j = 1:4) %>% filter(i > j) %>%
  mutate(jac = map2_dbl(i, j, ~ sum(m[, .x] == 1 & m[, .y] == 1) / sum(m[, .x] == 1 | m[, .y] == 1)),
         x = factor(short[keys[j]], short[keys[1:3]]), y = factor(short[keys[i]], rev(short[keys[2:4]])),
         tc = ifelse(jac > .5, "white", ink_t))
s2A <- ggplot(jac, aes(x, y, fill = jac)) + geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", jac), colour = tc), size = 3.3 * font_scale, family = fam) + scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = blue_ramp, limits = c(0, 1), name = "Jaccard index", breaks = c(0, .5, 1)) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = .5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + coord_fixed() + theme_ms(10) +
  theme(axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.width = unit(1.4, "lines"), legend.key.height = unit(.5, "lines"))
pat <- as_tibble(m) %>% count(across(all_of(keys)), name = "n") %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% mutate(id = row_number())
pat_long <- pat %>% pivot_longer(all_of(keys), names_to = "target", values_to = "on") %>% mutate(target = factor(target, rev(keys)))
s2B_top <- ggplot(pat, aes(factor(id), n)) + geom_col(width = .7, fill = "#184f95") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -.4, size = 3 * font_scale, colour = ink_t, family = fam) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .12))) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Plants") + theme_ms(10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.line.x = element_blank())
s2B_dot <- ggplot(pat_long, aes(factor(id), target)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = factor(on)), size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = pat_long %>% filter(on == 1), aes(group = id), colour = "#184f95", linewidth = .8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`0` = "#dedcd5", `1` = "#184f95"), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) unname(target_md[x])) + labs(x = "Detection pattern (ordered by frequency)", y = NULL) +
  theme_ms(10) + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank())
s2B <- wrap_elements(full = s2B_top / s2B_dot + plot_layout(heights = c(1.5, 1)))
S2 <- tag_wrap(s2A + s2B + plot_layout(widths = c(.8, 2.2)))
save_ms(S2, "S2_plant_level_2026_cooccurrence", 12.3, 4.5)
write_tab(pat %>% select(-id), "T_2026_stem_detection_patterns")
write_tab(jac %>% select(i, j, jac), "T_jaccard_2026_stem_exact")

show_fig("S2_plant_level_2026_cooccurrence")
```


```{r figS6, fig.keep='none'}
a <- raw_isolates
src <- a %>% transmute(isolate_code = `Isolate code`, source = Source) %>%
  mutate(source_type = case_when(is.na(source) ~ "Unknown", grepl("drone", source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Air (drone)",

iso <- D$iso %>% left_join(src, by = "isolate_code") %>%
```

```{r figS7, fig.keep='none'}
g7 <- D$geno %>% mutate(k = ifelse(is.na(decay_g), -1, decay_g)) %>% arrange(desc(k), desc(ani))

) %>% mutate(feature = factor(feature, c(feat_levels, "pitting"), labels = c("Pectin-like", "Hemicellulose-like", "Cellulose-like", "Effector candidate", "Pitting on CVP agar")),
```

## Figure S8. Mash distances among the reference genomes and the sequenced isolates

Mash distances (k-mer based; about 1 - ANI for distances below 0.1) from the Mashtree run (`mashtree_ALL_distances.tsv`). (A) Reference genomes only, lower triangle, approximate ANI (100 x (1 - Mash distance)); distances of 0.20 or more are saturated and shown as <80. (B) All genomes, ordered by average-linkage clustering; shading saturates at 0.20. Symbols on the right: circles, isolates with reported ANI of 95% or more; triangles, below 95%; diamonds, references. A dagger marks an assembly with about twice the usual number of fastANI query fragments (more than 1.6 times the median), which suggests more than one genome in the assembly (`fastani_allvsall.tsv`, optional). The figure is skipped when the distance file is absent.

```{r figS8-read}
data_path_dist <- file.path(data_dir, "mashtree_ALL_distances.tsv")
have_dist <- file.exists(data_path_dist)
if (!have_dist) cat("mashtree_ALL_distances.tsv was not found in", data_dir, "- Figure S8 is skipped.\n")
```

```{r figS8, fig.keep='none', eval = have_dist}
dm <- as.matrix(read.delim(data_path_dist, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
stopifnot("the distance matrix must be square with the same names on rows and columns" = nrow(dm) == ncol(dm) && all(rownames(dm) == colnames(dm)),
          "the distance matrix must be symmetric" = isSymmetric(unname(dm), tol = 1e-6))
dm_sat <- 0.20      # Mash distances at or above this are saturated (few shared k-mers)

fmt_ref_md <- function(lbl) vapply(lbl, function(l) {
  s <- sub("^(REF|OUT)_", "", l); s <- sub("^Erwinia_", "E", s)
  p <- strsplit(s, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  paste0("*", substr(p[1], 1, 1), ". ", substring(p[1], 2), "*", if (length(p) > 1) paste0(" ", paste(p[-1], collapse = " ")) else "")
}, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)

lab_tbl <- tibble(label = rownames(dm)) %>%
  mutate(kind = case_when(startsWith(label, "OUT_") ~ "outgroup", startsWith(label, "REF_") ~ "reference", TRUE ~ "isolate")) %>%
  left_join(feat_join %>% transmute(label = isolate_short, isolate_code), by = "label") %>%
  left_join(asm_flag, by = "label") %>%
  left_join(D$geno %>% transmute(isolate_code, ani, tier), by = "isolate_code") %>%
  mutate(flag = !is.na(flag) & flag,
         disp = ifelse(kind == "isolate", paste0("**", coalesce(isolate_code, label), "**", ifelse(flag, dagger, "")), fmt_ref_md(label)),
         shp  = case_when(kind != "isolate" ~ "ref", !is.na(tier) & tier == tier_lo ~ "lo", TRUE ~ "hi"))
lab_vec <- setNames(lab_tbl$disp, lab_tbl$label)

hc_order <- function(ids) if (length(ids) < 3) ids else ids[hclust(as.dist(dm[ids, ids]), "average")$order]
ref_ids <- lab_tbl$label[lab_tbl$kind != "isolate"]
ref_pec <- grep("^REF_P", ref_ids, value = TRUE); ref_dic <- grep("^REF_D", ref_ids, value = TRUE); ref_out <- grep("^OUT_", ref_ids, value = TRUE)
ord_ref <- c(hc_order(ref_pec), hc_order(ref_dic), ref_out)
ord_all <- hc_order(rownames(dm))
long_dm <- function(ord) expand_grid(r = ord, c = ord) %>% mutate(d = dm[cbind(r, c)], ri = match(r, ord), ci = match(c, ord))

fill_sc <- scale_fill_gradient(low = "#184f95", high = "#eef4fc", limits = c(0, dm_sat), oob = scales::squish, name = "Mash distance",
                               breaks = c(0, .05, .10, .15, .20), labels = c("0", "0.05", "0.10", "0.15", paste0(intToUtf8(0x2265), "0.20")),
                               guide = guide_colourbar(title.position = "left", title.vjust = .8, barwidth = unit(2.6, "in"), barheight = unit(.16, "in"), ticks.colour = "white"))
heat_theme <- theme_ms(9) + theme(axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(),
                                  axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = .5, colour = ink_t, size = 7 * font_scale),
                                  axis.text.y = element_markdown(colour = ink_t, size = 7 * font_scale))

# A. reference genomes, lower triangle, approximate ANI
a_dat <- long_dm(ord_ref) %>% filter(ri > ci) %>%
  mutate(txt = ifelse(d >= dm_sat, "<80", sprintf("%.1f", 100 * (1 - d))), txt_col = ifelse(d < .08, "white", ink_t),
         r = factor(r, rev(ord_ref)), c = factor(c, ord_ref))
pA <- ggplot(a_dat, aes(c, r, fill = d)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = .5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = txt, colour = txt_col), size = 2.5 * font_scale, family = fam) +
  scale_colour_identity() + fill_sc +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = ord_ref[-length(ord_ref)], labels = lab_vec) + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(ord_ref[-1]), labels = lab_vec) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, tag = "A") + heat_theme + theme(legend.position = "none")

# B. every genome
b_dat <- long_dm(ord_all) %>% mutate(r = factor(r, rev(ord_all)), c = factor(c, ord_all))
pB <- ggplot(b_dat, aes(c, r, fill = d)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = .15) + fill_sc +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = lab_vec) + scale_y_discrete(labels = lab_vec) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, tag = "B") + heat_theme + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
pM <- ggplot(lab_tbl %>% mutate(r = factor(label, rev(ord_all))), aes(1, r, shape = shp, fill = shp)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.3, colour = ink, stroke = .45) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(hi = 21, lo = 24, ref = 23), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(hi = ink2, lo = "white", ref = "#cfcec8"), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(ord_all)) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(.6, 1.4), expand = c(0, 0)) + theme_void()

unit_b <- 36                                   # panel units: one tile of B = 1 unit; one tile of A = 2.5 units
n_a   <- length(ord_ref) - 1
left  <- pA / plot_spacer() + plot_layout(heights = c(2.5 * n_a, unit_b - 2.5 * n_a))
S8 <- (left | pB | pM) + plot_layout(widths = c(2.5 * n_a, length(ord_all), 1.5), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.tag.position = c(0, 1), plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13 * font_scale, family = fam, colour = ink_t))
save_ms(S8, "S8_mash_distance_heatmap", 13.4, 8.4)

save_table(as_tibble(dm[ord_ref, ord_ref], rownames = "genome"), "T_S8_reference_mash_distance")
if (nrow(asm_flag) > 0) save_table(lab_tbl %>% filter(kind == "isolate") %>% transmute(isolate_code, genome = label, fastani_query_fragments = n_fragments,
                                                                                        median_fragments, flagged_more_than_1.6x_median = flag), "T_S8_assembly_fragment_counts")
show_fig("S8_mash_distance_heatmap")
```
